```{r Chunk 03 — Detect and extract METABRIC raw archive}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 03 — Detect and extract METABRIC raw archive
# Purpose:
#   Prepare raw METABRIC cBioPortal files for validation of GSE96058.
#   This chunk only detects/extracts files; expression and clinical loading
#   will be done in Chunk 04.
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
})

message("Raw path: ", paths$raw, " | exists: ", dir.exists(paths$raw))

stopifnot(dir.exists(paths$raw))

raw_files <- list.files(
  paths$raw,
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = FALSE
)

stopifnot(length(raw_files) > 0)

message("Files currently in METABRIC/01_raw:")
print(basename(raw_files))

# ----------------------------
# 03A — Detect METABRIC cBioPortal archive
# ----------------------------

archive_candidates <- list.files(
  paths$raw,
  pattern = "brca_metabric.*\\.(tar|tar\\.gz|tgz|gz)$|\\.tar$|\\.tar\\.gz$|\\.tgz$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (length(archive_candidates) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No METABRIC archive detected in: ", paths$raw, "\n",
    "Expected a cBioPortal archive such as brca_metabric.tar.gz, brca_metabric.tar, or .tgz."
  )
}

archive_sizes <- file.info(archive_candidates)$size
archive_fp <- archive_candidates[which.max(archive_sizes)]

message("Selected METABRIC archive: ", basename(archive_fp))
message("Archive size (MB): ", round(file.info(archive_fp)$size / 1024^2, 2))

stopifnot(file.exists(archive_fp))

# ----------------------------
# 03B — Extract safely
# ----------------------------

extract_dir <- file.path(paths$raw, "cbioportal_metabric")
dir.create(extract_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

already_extracted <- length(list.files(extract_dir, recursive = TRUE)) > 10

if (!already_extracted) {
  message("Extracting METABRIC archive...")
  utils::untar(archive_fp, exdir = extract_dir)
} else {
  message("Archive already appears extracted. Skipping extraction.")
}

extracted_files <- list.files(
  extract_dir,
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

stopifnot(length(extracted_files) > 0)

# ----------------------------
# 03C — Locate expected cBioPortal study folder/files
# ----------------------------

expr_hits <- extracted_files[
  grepl("data_mrna_illumina_microarray\\.txt$", extracted_files, ignore.case = TRUE)
]

patient_hits <- extracted_files[
  grepl("data_clinical_patient\\.txt$", extracted_files, ignore.case = TRUE)
]

sample_hits <- extracted_files[
  grepl("data_clinical_sample\\.txt$", extracted_files, ignore.case = TRUE)
]

if (length(expr_hits) < 1 || length(patient_hits) < 1 || length(sample_hits) < 1) {
  stop(
    "Required METABRIC cBioPortal files were not all found after extraction.\n",
    "Found expression files: ", length(expr_hits), "\n",
    "Found patient clinical files: ", length(patient_hits), "\n",
    "Found sample clinical files: ", length(sample_hits), "\n",
    "Please check the archive contents."
  )
}

expr_fp    <- expr_hits[1]
patient_fp <- patient_hits[1]
sample_fp  <- sample_hits[1]

study_dir <- dirname(expr_fp)

message("METABRIC study directory: ", study_dir)
message("Expression file: ", basename(expr_fp))
message("Patient clinical file: ", basename(patient_fp))
message("Sample clinical file: ", basename(sample_fp))

# ----------------------------
# 03D — Optional external clinical TSV detection
# ----------------------------

external_clinical_files <- list.files(
  paths$raw,
  pattern = "metabric.*clinical.*\\.(tsv|csv|txt)$|brca_metabric_clinical_data\\.(tsv|csv|txt)$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

external_clinical_files <- setdiff(external_clinical_files, archive_fp)

external_clinical_note <- if (length(external_clinical_files) > 0) {
  paste(basename(external_clinical_files), collapse = "; ")
} else {
  NA_character_
}

message("External clinical file(s): ", ifelse(is.na(external_clinical_note), "none detected", external_clinical_note))

# ----------------------------
# 03E — Save file manifest
# ----------------------------

qc_raw <- tibble::tibble(
  dataset = project$dataset,
  role = project$role,
  raw_type = project$raw_type,
  archive_file = basename(archive_fp),
  archive_size_MB = round(file.info(archive_fp)$size / 1024^2, 2),
  extract_dir = extract_dir,
  study_dir = study_dir,
  expression_file = basename(expr_fp),
  patient_clinical_file = basename(patient_fp),
  sample_clinical_file = basename(sample_fp),
  external_clinical_files = external_clinical_note,
  n_extracted_files = length(extracted_files)
)

readr::write_csv(
  qc_raw,
  file.path(paths$tables, "03_qc_METABRIC_raw_archive_manifest.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  list(
    archive_fp = archive_fp,
    extract_dir = extract_dir,
    study_dir = study_dir,
    expr_fp = expr_fp,
    patient_fp = patient_fp,
    sample_fp = sample_fp,
    external_clinical_files = external_clinical_files
  ),
  file.path(paths$processed, "03_METABRIC_raw_file_paths.rds")
)

message("Chunk 03 completed.")
message("Saved:")
message("- 03_qc_METABRIC_raw_archive_manifest.csv")
message("- 03_METABRIC_raw_file_paths.rds")

qc_raw

```
This chunk take long time 
```{r Chunk 04 — Load METABRIC expression_clinical and build aligned objects}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 04 — Load METABRIC expression + clinical and build aligned objects
# Purpose:
#   Build canonical METABRIC expression and clinical objects for validation
#   of the GSE96058 discovery pipeline.
#
# Outputs:
#   04_expr_mat_gene_by_sample.rds
#   04_clin_raw.rds
#   04_qc_expression_clinical_build.csv
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
})

raw_paths <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "03_METABRIC_raw_file_paths.rds"))

expr_fp    <- raw_paths$expr_fp
patient_fp <- raw_paths$patient_fp
sample_fp  <- raw_paths$sample_fp

stopifnot(file.exists(expr_fp))
stopifnot(file.exists(patient_fp))
stopifnot(file.exists(sample_fp))

message("Expression file: ", expr_fp)
message("Patient clinical file: ", patient_fp)
message("Sample clinical file: ", sample_fp)

# ----------------------------
# 04A — Helper functions
# ----------------------------

read_cbio_clinical <- function(fp) {

  lines <- readLines(fp, warn = FALSE)
  lines <- lines[!is.na(lines)]
  lines_ne <- lines[nzchar(trimws(lines))]

  idx_data_start <- which(!stringr::str_detect(lines_ne, "^#"))[1]

  if (is.na(idx_data_start)) {
    stop("No data/header line detected in clinical file: ", fp)
  }

  tf <- tempfile(fileext = ".txt")
  writeLines(lines_ne, tf)
  on.exit(unlink(tf), add = TRUE)

  dt <- data.table::fread(
    tf,
    skip = idx_data_start - 1,
    header = TRUE,
    data.table = FALSE,
    fill = TRUE
  )

  names(dt) <- make.names(trimws(names(dt)))
  dt
}

pick_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  hit <- intersect(candidates, names(df))
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  hit[1]
}

pick_by_regex <- function(nms, patterns) {
  nms_low <- tolower(nms)

  for (p in patterns) {
    hit <- nms[stringr::str_detect(nms_low, p)]
    if (length(hit) > 0) return(hit[1])
  }

  NA_character_
}

norm_id <- function(x) {
  stringr::str_replace_all(as.character(x), "[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]", "_")
}

# ----------------------------
# 04B — Load and clean expression matrix
# ----------------------------

expr_dt <- data.table::fread(expr_fp, data.table = FALSE)

stopifnot(ncol(expr_dt) > 10)

gene_col <- names(expr_dt)[1]
names(expr_dt)[1] <- "SYMBOL"

expr_dt <- expr_dt %>%
  mutate(
    SYMBOL = toupper(trimws(as.character(SYMBOL)))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SYMBOL), SYMBOL != "")

sample_cols <- setdiff(names(expr_dt), "SYMBOL")

non_numeric_cols <- sample_cols[
  !vapply(expr_dt[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE], is.numeric, logical(1))
]

if (length(non_numeric_cols) > 0) {
  message("Converting non-numeric expression columns to numeric: ",
          paste(non_numeric_cols, collapse = ", "))
  expr_dt[non_numeric_cols] <- lapply(
    expr_dt[non_numeric_cols],
    function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  )
}

USE_MEDIAN_COLLAPSE <- TRUE

collapse_fun <- if (USE_MEDIAN_COLLAPSE) {
  function(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
} else {
  function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

collapse_label <- ifelse(USE_MEDIAN_COLLAPSE, "median", "mean")

expr_dt_collapsed <- expr_dt %>%
  group_by(SYMBOL) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(sample_cols), collapse_fun),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

expr_mat <- as.matrix(expr_dt_collapsed[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])
rownames(expr_mat) <- expr_dt_collapsed$SYMBOL
storage.mode(expr_mat) <- "numeric"

# ----------------------------
# 04C — Load clinical patient + sample tables
# ----------------------------

cl_patient <- read_cbio_clinical(patient_fp)
cl_sample  <- read_cbio_clinical(sample_fp)

patient_id_candidates <- c(
  "PATIENT_ID", "Patient.ID", "patient_id",
  "PATIENT", "PATIENT.ID", "PATIENT_IDENTIFIER"
)

sample_id_candidates <- c(
  "SAMPLE_ID", "Sample.ID", "sample_id",
  "SAMPLE", "SAMPLE.ID", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
  "TUMOR_SAMPLE_BARCODE"
)

pat_col_patient <- pick_col(cl_patient, patient_id_candidates)
pat_col_sample  <- pick_col(cl_sample, patient_id_candidates)
sample_col      <- pick_col(cl_sample, sample_id_candidates)

if (is.na(pat_col_patient)) {
  pat_col_patient <- pick_by_regex(names(cl_patient), c("patient.*id", "^patient", "patient"))
}

if (is.na(pat_col_sample)) {
  pat_col_sample <- pick_by_regex(names(cl_sample), c("patient.*id", "^patient", "patient"))
}

if (is.na(sample_col)) {
  sample_col <- pick_by_regex(names(cl_sample), c("sample.*id", "^sample", "barcode", "tumor.*sample"))
}

if (is.na(pat_col_patient) || is.na(pat_col_sample) || is.na(sample_col)) {
  stop(
    "Could not identify patient/sample ID columns.\n",
    "Patient table columns: ", paste(names(cl_patient), collapse = ", "), "\n",
    "Sample table columns: ", paste(names(cl_sample), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

cl_patient <- cl_patient %>%
  mutate(PATIENT_ID = as.character(.data[[pat_col_patient]]))

cl_sample <- cl_sample %>%
  mutate(
    PATIENT_ID = as.character(.data[[pat_col_sample]]),
    SAMPLE_ID  = as.character(.data[[sample_col]])
  )

# ----------------------------
# 04D — Align expression samples to clinical samples
# ----------------------------

expr_ids <- colnames(expr_mat)

cl_sample <- cl_sample %>%
  mutate(SAMPLE_ID_NORM = norm_id(SAMPLE_ID))

expr_ids_norm <- norm_id(expr_ids)

m <- match(expr_ids_norm, cl_sample$SAMPLE_ID_NORM)
matched <- !is.na(m)

message("Expression samples: ", length(expr_ids))
message("Matched clinical samples: ", sum(matched))

stopifnot(sum(matched) > 100)

expr_mat_aligned <- expr_mat[, matched, drop = FALSE]
colnames(expr_mat_aligned) <- cl_sample$SAMPLE_ID[m[matched]]

clin_sample_aligned <- cl_sample[m[matched], , drop = FALSE] %>%
  dplyr::select(SAMPLE_ID, PATIENT_ID, everything())

clin_dt <- clin_sample_aligned %>%
  left_join(
    cl_patient %>% dplyr::select(PATIENT_ID, everything()),
    by = "PATIENT_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = as.character(SAMPLE_ID),
    patient_id = as.character(PATIENT_ID)
  )

stopifnot(ncol(expr_mat_aligned) == nrow(clin_dt))
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_mat_aligned) == clin_dt$sample_id))
stopifnot(anyDuplicated(clin_dt$sample_id) == 0)

# ----------------------------
# 04E — Optional external clinical file inventory only
# ----------------------------

external_files <- raw_paths$external_clinical_files

external_file_note <- if (length(external_files) > 0) {
  paste(basename(external_files), collapse = "; ")
} else {
  NA_character_
}

# ----------------------------
# 04F — QC + save
# ----------------------------

qc_build <- tibble::tibble(
  dataset = project$dataset,
  expression_file = basename(expr_fp),
  patient_clinical_file = basename(patient_fp),
  sample_clinical_file = basename(sample_fp),
  external_clinical_files = external_file_note,
  n_rows_raw_expr = nrow(expr_dt),
  n_unique_genes = nrow(expr_mat_aligned),
  n_expression_samples_raw = length(expr_ids),
  n_expression_samples_matched = ncol(expr_mat_aligned),
  n_clinical_sample_rows = nrow(cl_sample),
  n_clinical_patient_rows = nrow(cl_patient),
  duplicated_gene_rows = nrow(expr_dt) - nrow(expr_mat_aligned),
  collapse_method = collapse_label,
  pct_missing_values = mean(is.na(expr_mat_aligned)) * 100
)

readr::write_csv(
  qc_build,
  file.path(paths$tables, "04_qc_METABRIC_expression_clinical_build.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  expr_mat_aligned,
  file.path(paths$processed, "04_expr_mat_gene_by_sample.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  clin_dt,
  file.path(paths$processed, "04_clin_raw.rds")
)

message("METABRIC expression matrix built: ",
        nrow(expr_mat_aligned), " genes x ", ncol(expr_mat_aligned), " samples")

message("METABRIC clinical table built: ",
        nrow(clin_dt), " rows x ", ncol(clin_dt), " columns")

qc_build

```

```{r Chunk 05 — Validate alignment_enforce pipeline structure}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 05 — Validate alignment + enforce pipeline structure
# Purpose:
#   Ensure METABRIC matches GSE96058 pipeline expectations:
#   - expression columns == clinical sample_id
#   - no duplication
#   - stable ordering
#
# NOTE:
#   Unlike GSE96058, mapping already done in Chunk 04
#   This chunk = validation + standardization ONLY
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

expr_mat <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "04_expr_mat_gene_by_sample.rds"))
clin_dt  <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "04_clin_raw.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame()

message("Expression matrix: ", nrow(expr_mat), " genes x ", ncol(expr_mat), " samples")
message("Clinical table: ", nrow(clin_dt), " rows x ", ncol(clin_dt), " columns")

# ----------------------------
# 05A — Enforce sample_id column
# ----------------------------

if (!"sample_id" %in% names(clin_dt)) {
  stop("Clinical table must contain 'sample_id'")
}

clin_dt$sample_id <- as.character(clin_dt$sample_id)

# ----------------------------
# 05B — Validate alignment
# ----------------------------

expr_ids <- colnames(expr_mat)
clin_ids <- clin_dt$sample_id

stopifnot(length(expr_ids) == nrow(clin_dt))

# strict order check
if (!all(expr_ids == clin_ids)) {
  warning("Order mismatch detected — reordering clinical to match expression")

  clin_dt <- clin_dt[match(expr_ids, clin_ids), , drop = FALSE]
}

stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_mat) == clin_dt$sample_id))
stopifnot(anyDuplicated(clin_dt$sample_id) == 0)

# ----------------------------
# 05C — QC summary
# ----------------------------

qc_alignment <- tibble::tibble(
  dataset = project$dataset,
  n_expression_samples = length(expr_ids),
  n_clinical_rows = length(clin_ids),
  identical_order = all(expr_ids == clin_ids),
  duplicated_samples = anyDuplicated(clin_ids),
  first_5_ids = paste(head(expr_ids, 5), collapse = "; ")
)

readr::write_csv(
  qc_alignment,
  file.path(paths$tables, "05_qc_alignment_validation.csv")
)

# ----------------------------
# 05D — Save standardized objects
# ----------------------------

saveRDS(
  expr_mat,
  file.path(paths$processed, "05_expr_mat_named.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  clin_dt,
  file.path(paths$processed, "05_clin_raw_after_mapping.rds")
)

message("Alignment validated and standardized.")
qc_alignment

```


```{r Chunk 06 — Final aligned expression and clinical samples}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 06 — Final aligned expression and clinical samples
# Purpose:
#   Create canonical METABRIC aligned objects matching the GSE96058 pipeline.
#   Since METABRIC was already aligned in Chunk 04/05, this chunk confirms
#   alignment and saves 06_expr_mat_aligned.rds and 06_clin_aligned.rds.
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

expr_mat_named <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "05_expr_mat_named.rds"))
clin_dt        <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "05_clin_raw_after_mapping.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame()

stopifnot("sample_id" %in% names(clin_dt))

clin_dt$sample_id <- as.character(clin_dt$sample_id)

expr_ids <- colnames(expr_mat_named)
clin_ids <- clin_dt$sample_id

matched_ids <- expr_ids[expr_ids %in% clin_ids]

message("Expression samples: ", length(expr_ids))
message("Clinical rows: ", length(clin_ids))
message("Matched samples: ", length(matched_ids))

stopifnot(length(matched_ids) > 100)

expr_mat_aligned <- expr_mat_named[, matched_ids, drop = FALSE]
clin_dt_aligned  <- clin_dt[match(matched_ids, clin_dt$sample_id), , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(ncol(expr_mat_aligned) == nrow(clin_dt_aligned))
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_mat_aligned) == clin_dt_aligned$sample_id))
stopifnot(anyDuplicated(clin_dt_aligned$sample_id) == 0)

qc_alignment <- tibble::tibble(
  dataset              = project$dataset,
  expression_samples   = length(expr_ids),
  clinical_rows        = length(clin_ids),
  matched_samples      = length(matched_ids),
  expression_only      = length(setdiff(expr_ids, clin_ids)),
  clinical_only        = length(setdiff(clin_ids, expr_ids)),
  pct_expression_kept  = 100 * length(matched_ids) / length(expr_ids),
  pct_clinical_matched = 100 * length(matched_ids) / length(clin_ids),
  validation_note      = "METABRIC alignment confirmed; canonical 06 objects created for GSE96058 pipeline symmetry"
)

readr::write_csv(
  qc_alignment,
  file.path(paths$tables, "06_qc_expression_clinical_alignment.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  expr_mat_aligned,
  file.path(paths$processed, "06_expr_mat_aligned.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  clin_dt_aligned,
  file.path(paths$processed, "06_clin_aligned.rds")
)

message("Aligned expression matrix: ", nrow(expr_mat_aligned), " genes x ", ncol(expr_mat_aligned), " samples")
message("Aligned clinical table: ", nrow(clin_dt_aligned), " rows x ", ncol(clin_dt_aligned), " columns")

qc_alignment

```
```{r Chunk 07 — Standardize PAM50-like subtype and receptor annotations METABRIC}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 07 — Standardize PAM50-like subtype and receptor annotations (METABRIC)
# Purpose:
#   Prepare validation labels using the same logic as GSE96058:
#   1) multi-subtype analysis
#   2) focused ERpos vs TNBC contrast
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
})

expr_mat <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "06_expr_mat_aligned.rds"))
clin_dt  <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "06_clin_aligned.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

stopifnot(ncol(expr_mat) == nrow(clin_dt))
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_mat) == clin_dt$sample_id))

# ----------------------------
# 07A — Detect METABRIC columns
# ----------------------------

subtype_col <- "CLAUDIN_SUBTYPE"
er_col      <- "ER_STATUS"
pr_col      <- "PR_STATUS"
her2_col    <- "HER2_STATUS"

required_cols <- c("sample_id", subtype_col, er_col, pr_col, her2_col)
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(clin_dt))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required METABRIC columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}

# ----------------------------
# 07B — Helper functions
# ----------------------------

std_status <- function(x) {
  x_raw <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))

  dplyr::case_when(
    x_raw %in% c("positive", "pos", "+", "1", "yes", "y", "positve") ~ "Positive",
    x_raw %in% c("negative", "neg", "-", "0", "no", "n") ~ "Negative",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

std_pam50_metabric <- function(x) {
  x_raw <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))

  dplyr::case_when(
    x_raw %in% c("luma", "luminal a", "luminala") ~ "LumA",
    x_raw %in% c("lumb", "luminal b", "luminalb") ~ "LumB",
    x_raw %in% c("her2", "her2 enriched", "her2-enriched") ~ "HER2_enriched",
    x_raw %in% c("basal", "basal-like", "basal like") ~ "Basal",
    x_raw %in% c("normal", "normal-like", "normal like") ~ "Normal_like",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# 07C — Standardize annotations
# ----------------------------

clin_std <- clin_dt %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = as.character(sample_id),

    pam50_subtype = as.character(.data[[subtype_col]]),
    pam50_simple  = std_pam50_metabric(.data[[subtype_col]]),

    ER_status_std   = std_status(.data[[er_col]]),
    PGR_status_std  = std_status(.data[[pr_col]]),
    HER2_status_std = std_status(.data[[her2_col]]),

    pam50_simple = factor(
      pam50_simple,
      levels = c("LumA", "LumB", "HER2_enriched", "Basal", "Normal_like")
    ),

    broad_receptor_group = dplyr::case_when(
      ER_status_std == "Positive" & HER2_status_std == "Negative" ~ "ERpos_HER2neg",

      ER_status_std == "Negative" &
        PGR_status_std == "Negative" &
        HER2_status_std == "Negative" ~ "TNBC",

      HER2_status_std == "Positive" ~ "HER2pos",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC = dplyr::case_when(
      broad_receptor_group == "ERpos_HER2neg" ~ "ERpos",
      broad_receptor_group == "TNBC" ~ "TNBC",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC = factor(
      focused_group_ERpos_TNBC,
      levels = c("ERpos", "TNBC")
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# 07D — QC tables
# ----------------------------

qc_pam50 <- clin_std %>%
  dplyr::count(pam50_simple, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(frac = n / sum(n))

qc_receptor <- clin_std %>%
  dplyr::count(
    ER_status_std,
    PGR_status_std,
    HER2_status_std,
    broad_receptor_group,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

qc_pam50_by_receptor <- clin_std %>%
  dplyr::count(pam50_simple, broad_receptor_group, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(pam50_simple, desc(n))

qc_focused <- clin_std %>%
  dplyr::count(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(frac = n / sum(n))

qc_concordance <- clin_std %>%
  mutate(
    receptor_pam50_concordance = dplyr::case_when(
      broad_receptor_group == "ERpos_HER2neg" &
        pam50_simple %in% c("LumA", "LumB") ~ "Concordant_ERpos_Luminal",

      broad_receptor_group == "TNBC" &
        pam50_simple == "Basal" ~ "Concordant_TNBC_Basal",

      broad_receptor_group == "HER2pos" &
        pam50_simple == "HER2_enriched" ~ "Concordant_HER2pos_HER2enriched",

      is.na(broad_receptor_group) | is.na(pam50_simple) ~ "Insufficient_annotation",

      TRUE ~ "Discordant_or_mixed"
    )
  )

qc_concordance_counts <- qc_concordance %>%
  dplyr::count(receptor_pam50_concordance, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

# ----------------------------
# 07E — Save outputs
# ----------------------------

saveRDS(clin_std, file.path(paths$processed, "07_clin_standardized.rds"))
saveRDS(qc_concordance, file.path(paths$processed, "07_clin_with_concordance_labels.rds"))

readr::write_csv(qc_pam50, file.path(paths$tables, "07_qc_pam50_subtype_counts.csv"))
readr::write_csv(qc_receptor, file.path(paths$tables, "07_qc_receptor_group_counts.csv"))
readr::write_csv(qc_pam50_by_receptor, file.path(paths$tables, "07_qc_pam50_by_receptor_group.csv"))
readr::write_csv(qc_focused, file.path(paths$tables, "07_qc_focused_ERpos_TNBC_counts.csv"))
readr::write_csv(qc_concordance_counts, file.path(paths$tables, "07_qc_receptor_PAM50_concordance.csv"))

message("Chunk 07 completed: METABRIC annotations standardized.")
message("PAM50-like subtype counts:")
print(qc_pam50)

message("Focused ERpos/TNBC counts:")
print(qc_focused)

message("Receptor/PAM50-like concordance:")
print(qc_concordance_counts)

clin_std %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    pam50_subtype,
    pam50_simple,
    ER_status_std,
    PGR_status_std,
    HER2_status_std,
    broad_receptor_group,
    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC
  ) %>%
  head()
```


```{r Chunk 08 — Build METABRIC validation cohorts}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 08 — Build METABRIC validation cohorts
# Purpose:
#   1) Primary cohort: intrinsic subtype analysis
#      LumA, LumB, HER2_enriched, Basal, Normal_like
#   2) Focused cohort: receptor-defined ERpos vs TNBC contrast

pam50_keep <- c("LumA", "LumB", "HER2_enriched", "Basal", "Normal_like")

# ----------------------------
# 08B — Focused receptor-defined ERpos vs TNBC cohort
# ----------------------------

clin_focused <- clin_std %>%
  filter(!is.na(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC)) %>%

    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC = factor(
      as.character(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC),

  )

expr_focused <- expr_mat[, clin_focused$sample_id, drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_focused) == clin_focused$sample_id))

qc_focused_cohort <- clin_focused %>%

    cohort = "METABRIC_focused_ERpos_TNBC",

  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(cohort, focused_group_ERpos_TNBC, n, frac)

# ----------------------------
# 08C — Concordance labels
# ----------------------------

clin_concordance <- clin_std %>%
  mutate(
    receptor_pam50_concordance = dplyr::case_when(
      broad_receptor_group == "ERpos_HER2neg" &
        pam50_simple %in% c("LumA", "LumB") ~ "Concordant_ERpos_Luminal",

      broad_receptor_group == "TNBC" &
        pam50_simple == "Basal" ~ "Concordant_TNBC_Basal",

      broad_receptor_group == "HER2pos" &
        pam50_simple == "HER2_enriched" ~ "Concordant_HER2pos_HER2enriched",

      is.na(broad_receptor_group) | is.na(pam50_simple) ~ "Insufficient_annotation",

      TRUE ~ "Discordant_or_mixed"
    )
  )

qc_concordance <- clin_concordance %>%
  dplyr::count(receptor_pam50_concordance, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

# ----------------------------
# 08D — Save outputs
# ----------------------------

saveRDS(expr_pam50, file.path(paths$processed, "08_expr_PAM50_primary.rds"))
saveRDS(clin_pam50, file.path(paths$processed, "08_clin_PAM50_primary.rds"))

saveRDS(expr_focused, file.path(paths$processed, "08_expr_focused_ERpos_TNBC.rds"))
saveRDS(clin_focused, file.path(paths$processed, "08_clin_focused_ERpos_TNBC.rds"))

saveRDS(clin_concordance, file.path(paths$processed, "08_clin_with_concordance_labels.rds"))

readr::write_csv(qc_pam50_cohort, file.path(paths$tables, "08_qc_PAM50_primary_cohort.csv"))

writeLines(

    "",

    "",

    "This mirrors the GSE96058 discovery design while acknowledging METABRIC subtype labels come from CLAUDIN_SUBTYPE annotation."
  ),

)
```

```{r Chunk 09 — Handle technical replicates and cohort QC (METABRIC)}



# ----------------------------
# Chunk 09 — Handle technical replicates and cohort QC (METABRIC)
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
})

expr_pam50 <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "08_expr_PAM50_primary.rds"))
clin_pam50 <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "08_clin_PAM50_primary.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

expr_focused <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "08_expr_focused_ERpos_TNBC.rds"))
clin_focused <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "08_clin_focused_ERpos_TNBC.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_pam50) == clin_pam50$sample_id))
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_focused) == clin_focused$sample_id))

KEEP_PRIMARY_ONLY <- TRUE

detect_replicates <- function(clin_tbl) {
  clin_tbl %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sample_id  = as.character(sample_id),
      patient_id = as.character(patient_id),
      is_repl = duplicated(patient_id) | duplicated(patient_id, fromLast = TRUE)
    )
}

make_repSAFE <- function(expr_mat, clin_tbl, cohort_label) {

  clin_tbl <- detect_replicates(clin_tbl)

  rep_qc <- clin_tbl %>%
    dplyr::count(is_repl, name = "n") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cohort = cohort_label,
      KEEP_PRIMARY_ONLY = KEEP_PRIMARY_ONLY
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(cohort, KEEP_PRIMARY_ONLY, is_repl, n)

  if (KEEP_PRIMARY_ONLY) {

    clin_out <- clin_tbl %>%
      dplyr::group_by(patient_id) %>%
      dplyr::slice(1) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()

    expr_out <- expr_mat[, clin_out$sample_id, drop = FALSE]

    note <- paste0(
      cohort_label,
      ": KEEP_PRIMARY_ONLY=TRUE | kept ",
      ncol(expr_out),
      " unique patient/sample profiles."
    )

  } else {

    uniq_pid <- unique(clin_tbl$patient_id)

    expr_out <- sapply(uniq_pid, function(id) {
      cols <- clin_tbl$sample_id[clin_tbl$patient_id == id]

      if (length(cols) == 1) {
        expr_mat[, cols]
      } else {
        rowMeans(expr_mat[, cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
      }
    })

    expr_out <- as.matrix(expr_out)
    rownames(expr_out) <- rownames(expr_mat)
    colnames(expr_out) <- uniq_pid

    clin_out <- clin_tbl %>%
      dplyr::group_by(patient_id) %>%
      dplyr::slice(1) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(sample_id = patient_id)

    note <- paste0(
      cohort_label,
      ": KEEP_PRIMARY_ONLY=FALSE | collapsed to ",
      ncol(expr_out),
      " patient-level profiles."
    )
  }

  stopifnot(ncol(expr_out) == nrow(clin_out))
  stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_out) == clin_out$sample_id))
  stopifnot(anyDuplicated(clin_out$sample_id) == 0)

  list(
    expr = expr_out,
    clin = clin_out,
    rep_qc = rep_qc,
    note = note
  )
}

pam50_repSAFE <- make_repSAFE(
  expr_mat = expr_pam50,
  clin_tbl = clin_pam50,
  cohort_label = "METABRIC_PAM50_primary"
)

focused_repSAFE <- make_repSAFE(
  expr_mat = expr_focused,
  clin_tbl = clin_focused,
  cohort_label = "METABRIC_Focused_ERpos_TNBC"
)

qc_pam50_repSAFE <- pam50_repSAFE$clin %>%
  dplyr::count(pam50_simple, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cohort = "PAM50_primary_repSAFE", frac = n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::select(cohort, pam50_simple, n, frac)

qc_focused_repSAFE <- focused_repSAFE$clin %>%
  dplyr::count(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cohort = "Focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE", frac = n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::select(cohort, focused_group_ERpos_TNBC, n, frac)

qc_replicates <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  pam50_repSAFE$rep_qc,
  focused_repSAFE$rep_qc
)

saveRDS(pam50_repSAFE$expr, file.path(paths$processed, "09_expr_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds"))
saveRDS(pam50_repSAFE$clin, file.path(paths$processed, "09_clin_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds"))

saveRDS(focused_repSAFE$expr, file.path(paths$processed, "09_expr_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds"))
saveRDS(focused_repSAFE$clin, file.path(paths$processed, "09_clin_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds"))

readr::write_csv(qc_replicates, file.path(paths$tables, "09_qc_replicate_detection.csv"))
readr::write_csv(qc_pam50_repSAFE, file.path(paths$tables, "09_qc_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.csv"))
readr::write_csv(qc_focused_repSAFE, file.path(paths$tables, "09_qc_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.csv"))

writeLines(
  c(pam50_repSAFE$note, focused_repSAFE$note),
  con = file.path(paths$tables, "09_replicate_handling_note.txt")
)

message("PAM50 primary cohort after replicate handling:")
print(qc_pam50_repSAFE)

message("Focused ERpos/TNBC cohort after replicate handling:")
print(qc_focused_repSAFE)

message("Replicate QC:")
print(qc_replicates)
```

```{r Chunk 10 — Conservative ferroptosis axes for METABRIC validation}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 10 — Conservative ferroptosis axes for METABRIC validation
# Pipeline logic:
#   Axis score → marker genes → wiring → robustness → validation
#
# Purpose:
#   Use the exact same conservative CORE ferroptosis axes as GSE96058.
#   This ensures METABRIC is a true validation cohort, not a redefined analysis.
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
})

expr_pam50 <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "09_expr_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds"))

# ----------------------------
# 10A — Conservative CORE axes for scoring
# ----------------------------

ferro_axes_core <- list(

  Xc_GSH = c(
    "SLC7A11", "SLC3A2",
    "GCLC", "GCLM", "GSS", "GSR"
  ),

  GPX4_Selenium = c(
    "GPX4",
    "SEPHS2", "PSTK", "SEPSECS", "EEFSEC", "SECISBP2"
  ),

  FSP1_CoQ = c(
    "AIFM2",
    "PDSS1", "PDSS2",
    "COQ2", "COQ6", "COQ7", "COQ9", "COQ10A", "COQ10B"
  ),

  BH4_GCH1 = c(
    "GCH1", "PTS", "SPR", "QDPR", "DHFR"
  ),

  DHODH_Mito = c(
    "DHODH", "CISD1", "CISD2"
  ),

  Iron_Handling = c(
    "TFRC", "SLC11A2", "STEAP3",
    "FTH1", "FTL",
    "NCOA4", "SLC40A1"
  ),

  PUFA_Loading = c(
    "ACSL4", "LPCAT3", "FADS1", "FADS2"
  ),

  Lipid_Peroxidation = c(
    "ALOX5", "ALOX12", "ALOX15",
    "POR", "NOX1", "NOX4"
  )
)

ferro_axes_core <- lapply(
  ferro_axes_core,
  function(x) unique(toupper(trimws(x[!is.na(x) & x != ""])))
)

AXES_ORDER <- names(ferro_axes_core)

# ----------------------------
# 10B — Support genes, not used for primary scoring
# ----------------------------

ferro_support_genes <- list(

  NRF2_Stress_Response = c(
    "NFE2L2", "KEAP1", "HMOX1", "NQO1", "TXNRD1"
  ),

  Ferroptosis_Response_Markers = c(
    "PTGS2", "CHAC1", "SAT1"
  ),

  MUFA_Remodeling_Resistance = c(
    "ACSL3", "SCD", "MBOAT1", "MBOAT2"
  ),

  Additional_NEET_Mito = c(
    "CISD3"
  ),

  Additional_Selenium_Redox = c(
    "SCLY", "PRDX6"
  )
)

ferro_support_genes <- lapply(
  ferro_support_genes,
  function(x) unique(toupper(trimws(x[!is.na(x) & x != ""])))
)

# ----------------------------
# 10C — Axis membership tables
# ----------------------------

axis_gene_table_core <- tibble::tibble(
  axis = rep(names(ferro_axes_core), lengths(ferro_axes_core)),
  gene = unlist(ferro_axes_core, use.names = FALSE),
  role = "core_scoring_gene"
) %>%
  arrange(axis, gene)

axis_gene_table_support <- tibble::tibble(
  support_group = rep(names(ferro_support_genes), lengths(ferro_support_genes)),
  gene = unlist(ferro_support_genes, use.names = FALSE),
  role = "support_not_primary_scoring"
) %>%
  arrange(support_group, gene)

dup_core_genes <- axis_gene_table_core %>%
  dplyr::count(gene, name = "n_axes") %>%
  filter(n_axes > 1)

if (nrow(dup_core_genes) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Core scoring genes overlap between axes: ",
    paste(dup_core_genes$gene, collapse = ", "),
    ". Fix before scoring."
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# 10D — METABRIC coverage QC
# ----------------------------

available_genes <- rownames(expr_pam50)

axis_coverage_core <- axis_gene_table_core %>%
  mutate(
    present_in_METABRIC = gene %in% available_genes
  ) %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes_defined = n(),
    n_genes_present = sum(present_in_METABRIC),
    coverage_frac = n_genes_present / n_genes_defined,
    present_genes = paste(gene[present_in_METABRIC], collapse = "; "),
    missing_genes = paste(gene[!present_in_METABRIC], collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(axis, AXES_ORDER))

support_gene_coverage <- axis_gene_table_support %>%
  mutate(
    present_in_METABRIC = gene %in% available_genes
  ) %>%
  group_by(support_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes_defined = n(),
    n_genes_present = sum(present_in_METABRIC),
    coverage_frac = n_genes_present / n_genes_defined,
    present_genes = paste(gene[present_in_METABRIC], collapse = "; "),
    missing_genes = paste(gene[!present_in_METABRIC], collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

low_coverage_axes <- axis_coverage_core %>%
  filter(coverage_frac < SPEC$min_axis_cov)

if (nrow(low_coverage_axes) > 0) {
  warning(
    "Low-coverage CORE axes detected in METABRIC: ",
    paste(low_coverage_axes$axis, collapse = ", "),
    ". Review before scoring."
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# 10E — Save outputs
# ----------------------------

saveRDS(ferro_axes_core, file.path(paths$processed, "10_ferro_axes_CORE_scoring.rds"))
saveRDS(ferro_support_genes, file.path(paths$processed, "10_ferro_support_genes_not_scoring.rds"))
saveRDS(AXES_ORDER, file.path(paths$processed, "10_axes_order.rds"))

readr::write_csv(
  axis_gene_table_core,
  file.path(paths$tables, "10_CORE_ferroptosis_axis_gene_membership.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  axis_gene_table_support,
  file.path(paths$tables, "10_SUPPORT_ferroptosis_genes_not_primary_scoring.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  axis_coverage_core,
  file.path(paths$tables, "10_CORE_ferroptosis_axis_gene_coverage_METABRIC.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  support_gene_coverage,
  file.path(paths$tables, "10_SUPPORT_gene_coverage_METABRIC.csv")
)

writeLines(
  c(
    "METABRIC conservative ferroptosis axis strategy",
    "",
    "Validation principle:",
    "The same conservative core ferroptosis axes used in GSE96058 discovery are used here.",
    "No axis definitions are changed in METABRIC.",
    "",
    "Primary scoring axes:",
    paste0("- ", AXES_ORDER),
    "",
    "Interpretation rule:",
    "Axis-level scores are the primary validation evidence.",
    "Single genes are used later only as marker-level support and validation candidates.",
    "",
    "Rationale:",
    "This preserves discovery-validation symmetry and avoids dataset-specific axis tuning."
  ),
  con = file.path(paths$tables, "10_METABRIC_conservative_axis_strategy_note.txt")
)

message("Conservative core ferroptosis axes defined for METABRIC: ", length(ferro_axes_core))
message("METABRIC core axis coverage:")
print(axis_coverage_core)

message("METABRIC support gene coverage:")
print(support_gene_coverage)

axis_gene_table_core

```


```{r Chunk 11 — Gene-wise Z-score matrices for METABRIC}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 11 — Gene-wise Z-score matrices for METABRIC
# Pipeline:
#   Axis score → marker genes → wiring → robustness → validation
#
# Purpose:
#   Convert METABRIC expression to gene-wise Z-scores within each cohort.
#   This makes genes comparable before calculating ferroptosis axis scores.
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(matrixStats)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
})

expr_pam50   <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "09_expr_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds"))
clin_pam50   <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "09_clin_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame()

expr_focused <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "09_expr_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds"))
clin_focused <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "09_clin_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame()

stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_pam50) == clin_pam50$sample_id))
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_focused) == clin_focused$sample_id))

# ----------------------------
# 11A — Z-score function
# ----------------------------

make_gene_z <- function(expr_mat, cohort_label) {

  row_means <- rowMeans(expr_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  row_sds   <- matrixStats::rowSds(expr_mat, na.rm = TRUE)

  row_sds[!is.finite(row_sds) | row_sds == 0] <- NA_real_

  expr_z <- sweep(expr_mat, 1, row_means, "-")
  expr_z <- sweep(expr_z, 1, row_sds, "/")
  expr_z[!is.finite(expr_z)] <- NA_real_

  qc_z <- tibble::tibble(
    dataset = project$dataset,
    cohort = cohort_label,
    n_genes = nrow(expr_z),
    n_samples = ncol(expr_z),
    pct_missing_z = mean(is.na(expr_z)) * 100,
    n_zero_or_invalid_sd_genes = sum(is.na(row_sds)),
    median_gene_sd_raw = median(row_sds, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  list(expr_z = expr_z, qc = qc_z)
}

# ----------------------------
# 11B — Create Z-score matrices
# ----------------------------

z_pam50 <- make_gene_z(
  expr_mat = expr_pam50,
  cohort_label = "METABRIC_PAM50_primary_repSAFE"
)

z_focused <- make_gene_z(
  expr_mat = expr_focused,
  cohort_label = "METABRIC_Focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE"
)

# ----------------------------
# 11C — Save outputs
# ----------------------------

saveRDS(
  z_pam50$expr_z,
  file.path(paths$processed, "11_expr_z_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  z_focused$expr_z,
  file.path(paths$processed, "11_expr_z_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds")
)

qc_z_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(z_pam50$qc, z_focused$qc)

readr::write_csv(
  qc_z_all,
  file.path(paths$tables, "11_qc_gene_wise_zscore_matrices_METABRIC.csv")
)

message("METABRIC gene-wise Z-score matrices created.")
print(qc_z_all)

```

```{r Chunk 12 — Ferroptosis axis scores for METABRIC validation}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 12 — Ferroptosis axis scores for METABRIC validation
# Pipeline:
#   Axis score → marker genes → wiring → robustness → validation
#
# Purpose:
#   Compute:
#     1) Weighted module scores (PRIMARY)
#     2) Unweighted mean-Z scores (SENSITIVITY)
#
# Rule:
#   Use the same conservative CORE axes as GSE96058.
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
  library(matrixStats)
})

expr_z_pam50   <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "11_expr_z_PAM50_primary_repSAFE.rds"))
expr_z_focused <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "11_expr_z_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds"))

ferro_axes_core <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "10_ferro_axes_CORE_scoring.rds"))
AXES_ORDER      <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "10_axes_order.rds"))

# ----------------------------
# 12A — Axis scoring function
# ----------------------------

compute_axis_scores <- function(expr_z, axes_list, cohort_label) {

  gene_sd <- matrixStats::rowSds(expr_z, na.rm = TRUE)

  axis_scores_weighted <- list()
  axis_scores_unweighted <- list()
  axis_qc <- list()

  for (ax in names(axes_list)) {

    genes <- axes_list[[ax]]
    genes_present <- intersect(genes, rownames(expr_z))

    if (length(genes_present) == 0) {
      warning("Axis ", ax, " has zero available genes in ", cohort_label)
      next
    }

    sub_mat <- expr_z[genes_present, , drop = FALSE]
    weights <- gene_sd[genes_present]

    valid <- is.finite(weights) & !is.na(weights) & weights > 0
    sub_mat <- sub_mat[valid, , drop = FALSE]
    weights <- weights[valid]

    if (length(weights) == 0) {
      warning("Axis ", ax, " has no valid weighted genes in ", cohort_label)
      next
    }

    weights <- weights / sum(weights)

    score_w <- colSums(sweep(sub_mat, 1, weights, "*"), na.rm = TRUE)
    score_u <- colMeans(sub_mat, na.rm = TRUE)

    axis_scores_weighted[[ax]] <- score_w
    axis_scores_unweighted[[ax]] <- score_u

    axis_qc[[ax]] <- tibble::tibble(
      dataset = project$dataset,
      cohort = cohort_label,
      axis = ax,
      n_genes_defined = length(genes),
      n_genes_present = length(genes_present),
      n_genes_used = nrow(sub_mat),
      coverage_frac = nrow(sub_mat) / length(genes),
      genes_used = paste(rownames(sub_mat), collapse = "; ")
    )
  }

  scores_w <- as.data.frame(axis_scores_weighted)
  scores_u <- as.data.frame(axis_scores_unweighted)

  scores_w <- scores_w[, AXES_ORDER, drop = FALSE]
  scores_u <- scores_u[, AXES_ORDER, drop = FALSE]

  scores_w$sample_id <- colnames(expr_z)
  scores_u$sample_id <- colnames(expr_z)

  scores_w <- tibble::as_tibble(scores_w)
  scores_u <- tibble::as_tibble(scores_u)

  qc <- dplyr::bind_rows(axis_qc)

  list(
    weighted = scores_w,
    unweighted = scores_u,
    qc = qc
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# 12B — Compute scores
# ----------------------------

scores_pam50 <- compute_axis_scores(
  expr_z = expr_z_pam50,
  axes_list = ferro_axes_core,
  cohort_label = "METABRIC_PAM50_primary"
)

scores_focused <- compute_axis_scores(
  expr_z = expr_z_focused,
  axes_list = ferro_axes_core,
  cohort_label = "METABRIC_Focused_ERpos_TNBC"
)

# ----------------------------
# 12C — Save outputs
# ----------------------------

saveRDS(
  scores_pam50$weighted,
  file.path(paths$processed, "12_scores_weighted_PAM50.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  scores_pam50$unweighted,
  file.path(paths$processed, "12_scores_unweighted_PAM50.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  scores_focused$weighted,
  file.path(paths$processed, "12_scores_weighted_focused.rds")
)

saveRDS(
  scores_focused$unweighted,
  file.path(paths$processed, "12_scores_unweighted_focused.rds")
)

qc_axes <- dplyr::bind_rows(scores_pam50$qc, scores_focused$qc)

readr::write_csv(
  qc_axes,
  file.path(paths$tables, "12_qc_axis_gene_coverage_used_METABRIC.csv")
)

message("METABRIC axis scoring completed.")
print(qc_axes)

```

```{r Chunk 13 — Add clinical labels to METABRIC axis scores}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
```

```{r Chunk 14 — METABRIC PAM50 axis comparison + publication visualization}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 14 — METABRIC PAM50 axis comparison + publication visualization
# Adds:
#   1) Global Kruskal-Wallis BH-FDR labels on boxplots
#   2) Row-clustered heatmap while keeping PAM50 subtype order fixed
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(forcats)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(rstatix)
  library(stringr)
})

scores_w_pam50 <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_weighted_PAM50_labeled.rds"))
AXES_ORDER <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "10_axes_order.rds"))

pam50_levels <- c("LumA", "LumB", "HER2_enriched", "Basal", "Normal_like")

scores_long <- scores_w_pam50 %>%
  mutate(
    pam50_simple = factor(as.character(pam50_simple), levels = pam50_levels)
  ) %>%
  select(sample_id, pam50_simple, all_of(AXES_ORDER)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(AXES_ORDER),
    names_to = "axis",
    values_to = "weighted_axis_score"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(pam50_simple),
    is.finite(weighted_axis_score),
    pam50_simple %in% pam50_levels
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    axis = factor(as.character(axis), levels = AXES_ORDER),
    pam50_simple = factor(as.character(pam50_simple), levels = pam50_levels)
  )

# ----------------------------
# 14A — Global Kruskal-Wallis test per axis
# ----------------------------

kw_pam50 <- scores_long %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  rstatix::kruskal_test(weighted_axis_score ~ pam50_simple) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    FDR_BH = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
    FDR_label = case_when(
      FDR_BH < 0.001 ~ "BH-FDR < 0.001",
      FDR_BH < 0.01  ~ "BH-FDR < 0.01",
      FDR_BH < 0.05  ~ "BH-FDR < 0.05",
      TRUE ~ paste0("BH-FDR = ", signif(FDR_BH, 2))
    ),
    significant_FDR_0.05 = FDR_BH < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(FDR_BH)

# Label positions for boxplots
label_pos <- scores_long %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  summarise(
    y_pos = max(weighted_axis_score, na.rm = TRUE) +
      0.08 * diff(range(weighted_axis_score, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(kw_pam50 %>% select(axis, FDR_label), by = "axis") %>%
  mutate(
    pam50_simple = pam50_levels[1]
  )

# ----------------------------
# 14B — Pairwise Wilcoxon tests
# ----------------------------

pairwise_pam50 <- scores_long %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  rstatix::pairwise_wilcox_test(
    weighted_axis_score ~ pam50_simple,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(axis, p.adj)

# ----------------------------
# 14C — Median heatmap table
# ----------------------------

axis_medians <- scores_long %>%
  group_by(axis, pam50_simple) %>%
  summarise(
    median_score = median(weighted_axis_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_score = mean(weighted_axis_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score = sd(weighted_axis_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  mutate(
    centered_median = median_score - median(median_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    highest_subtype = pam50_simple[which.max(median_score)],
    lowest_subtype = pam50_simple[which.min(median_score)]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ----------------------------
# 14D — Row clustering for heatmap only
# Keep subtype order fixed
# ----------------------------

heat_mat <- axis_medians %>%
  select(axis, pam50_simple, centered_median) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = pam50_simple,
    values_from = centered_median
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(heat_mat) <- heat_mat$axis
heat_mat$axis <- NULL

heat_mat <- heat_mat[, pam50_levels, drop = FALSE]

axis_cluster_order <- rownames(heat_mat)[
  hclust(dist(as.matrix(heat_mat)), method = "complete")$order
]

axis_medians_clustered <- axis_medians %>%
  mutate(
    axis_clustered = factor(as.character(axis), levels = rev(axis_cluster_order)),
    pam50_simple = factor(as.character(pam50_simple), levels = pam50_levels)
  )

# ----------------------------
# 14E — Save statistical tables
# ----------------------------

readr::write_csv(
  kw_pam50,
  file.path(paths$tables, "14_METABRIC_PAM50_weighted_axis_KruskalWallis.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  pairwise_pam50,
  file.path(paths$tables, "14_METABRIC_PAM50_weighted_axis_pairwise_Wilcoxon.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  axis_medians,
  file.path(paths$tables, "14_METABRIC_PAM50_axis_median_scores.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  axis_medians_clustered,
  file.path(paths$tables, "14_METABRIC_PAM50_axis_median_scores_row_clustered.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  tibble(axis_order_clustered = axis_cluster_order),
  file.path(paths$tables, "14_METABRIC_PAM50_heatmap_row_cluster_order.csv")
)

# ----------------------------
# 14F — Publication boxplot with BH-FDR annotation
# ----------------------------

p_box <- ggplot(
  scores_long,
  aes(x = pam50_simple, y = weighted_axis_score, fill = pam50_simple)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.75,
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.18,
    alpha = 0.18,
    size = 0.45,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = label_pos,
    aes(x = pam50_simple, y = y_pos, label = FDR_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.2,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ axis, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "METABRIC validation: ferroptosis axis activity across intrinsic breast cancer subtypes",
    subtitle = "Primary weighted module scores; global Kruskal-Wallis BH-FDR shown per axis",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Weighted ferroptosis axis score"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# ----------------------------
# 14G — Row-clustered heatmap
# ----------------------------

p_heat_clustered <- ggplot(
  axis_medians_clustered,
  aes(x = pam50_simple, y = axis_clustered, fill = centered_median)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", median_score)), size = 3.6) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Centered\nmedian"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "METABRIC validation: median ferroptosis axis pattern by intrinsic subtype",
    subtitle = "Rows are clustered by centered median axis activity; PAM50 subtype order is fixed",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

# ----------------------------
# 14H — Save figures
# ----------------------------

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(paths$figures, "14_METABRIC_PAM50_axis_boxplots_with_BHFDR.png"),
  plot = p_box,
  width = 14,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 450,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(paths$figures, "14_METABRIC_PAM50_axis_boxplots_with_BHFDR.pdf"),
  plot = p_box,
  width = 14,
  height = 8,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(paths$figures, "14_METABRIC_PAM50_axis_median_heatmap_row_clustered.png"),
  plot = p_heat_clustered,
  width = 11,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 450,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(paths$figures, "14_METABRIC_PAM50_axis_median_heatmap_row_clustered.pdf"),
  plot = p_heat_clustered,
  width = 11,
  height = 7,
  bg = "white"
)

message("Updated METABRIC Chunk 14 completed.")
message("Saved publication-ready figures:")
message("- 14_METABRIC_PAM50_axis_boxplots_with_BHFDR.png/pdf")
message("- 14_METABRIC_PAM50_axis_median_heatmap_row_clustered.png/pdf")

print(kw_pam50)

p_box
p_heat_clustered
```

```{r Chunk 15 — METABRIC focused ERpos vs TNBC ferroptosis axis signature}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 15 — METABRIC focused ERpos vs TNBC ferroptosis axis signature
# Pipeline:
#   Axis score → marker genes → wiring → robustness → validation
#
# Purpose:
#   Validate the focused GSE96058 ERpos/TNBC axis signature in METABRIC.
#   Positive Cliff's delta = higher TNBC axis activity.
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(rstatix)
  library(forcats)
})

scores_w_focus <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_weighted_focused_labeled.rds"))
scores_u_focus <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_unweighted_focused_labeled.rds"))
AXES_ORDER <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "10_axes_order.rds"))

# ----------------------------
# 15A — Manual Cliff's delta function
# ----------------------------

cliffs_delta_manual <- function(x_tnbc, x_erpos) {
  x_tnbc <- x_tnbc[is.finite(x_tnbc)]
  x_erpos <- x_erpos[is.finite(x_erpos)]

  if (length(x_tnbc) == 0 || length(x_erpos) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  cmp <- outer(x_tnbc, x_erpos, "-")
  (sum(cmp > 0) - sum(cmp < 0)) / (length(x_tnbc) * length(x_erpos))
}

# ----------------------------
# 15B — Prepare long tables
# ----------------------------

make_focus_long <- function(scores_df, score_label) {
  scores_df %>%
    mutate(
      focused_group_ERpos_TNBC = factor(
        as.character(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC),
        levels = c("ERpos", "TNBC")
      )
    ) %>%
    select(sample_id, focused_group_ERpos_TNBC, all_of(AXES_ORDER)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(AXES_ORDER),
      names_to = "axis",
      values_to = "axis_score"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC), is.finite(axis_score)) %>%
    mutate(
      axis = factor(axis, levels = AXES_ORDER),
      score_type = score_label
    )
}

focus_w_long <- make_focus_long(scores_w_focus, "weighted_primary")
focus_u_long <- make_focus_long(scores_u_focus, "unweighted_sensitivity")

# ----------------------------
# 15C — Weighted primary statistics
# ----------------------------

axis_stats_w <- focus_w_long %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ERpos = sum(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"),
    n_TNBC  = sum(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"),
    median_ERpos = median(axis_score[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_TNBC  = median(axis_score[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"], na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_median = median_TNBC - median_ERpos,
    cliffs_delta = cliffs_delta_manual(
      axis_score[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"],
      axis_score[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"]
    ),
    wilcox_p = wilcox.test(
      axis_score ~ focused_group_ERpos_TNBC,
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    wilcox_fdr = p.adjust(wilcox_p, method = "BH"),
    evidence = case_when(
      wilcox_fdr < 0.05 & abs(cliffs_delta) >= 0.30 ~ "Strong",
      wilcox_fdr < 0.05 & abs(cliffs_delta) >= 0.15 ~ "Moderate",
      TRUE ~ "Not_significant"
    ),
    direction = case_when(
      cliffs_delta > 0 ~ "Higher_in_TNBC",
      cliffs_delta < 0 ~ "Higher_in_ERpos",
      TRUE ~ "No_direction"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(cliffs_delta))

readr::write_csv(
  axis_stats_w,
  file.path(paths$tables, "15_METABRIC_focused_ERpos_TNBC_axis_statistics_weighted.csv")
)

# ----------------------------
# 15D — Weighted vs unweighted consistency
# ----------------------------

calc_delta_by_scoretype <- function(df_long) {
  df_long %>%
    group_by(axis, score_type) %>%
    summarise(
      cliffs_delta = cliffs_delta_manual(
        axis_score[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"],
        axis_score[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"]
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

consistency_tbl <- bind_rows(focus_w_long, focus_u_long) %>%
  calc_delta_by_scoretype() %>%
  mutate(axis = factor(axis, levels = AXES_ORDER))

readr::write_csv(
  consistency_tbl,
  file.path(paths$tables, "15_METABRIC_weighted_unweighted_axis_consistency.csv")
)

# ----------------------------
# 15E — Forest-style axis signature plot
# ----------------------------

plot_df <- axis_stats_w %>%
  mutate(
    axis = factor(axis, levels = rev(axis)),
    evidence = factor(evidence, levels = c("Strong", "Moderate", "Not_significant"))
  )

p_axis <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = cliffs_delta, y = axis, shape = evidence)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, xend = cliffs_delta, y = axis, yend = axis),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3.2) +
  labs(
    title = "METABRIC validation: focused ERpos vs TNBC ferroptosis axis signature",
    subtitle = "Cliff's delta from weighted axis scores; positive values indicate higher TNBC activity",
    x = "Cliff's delta (TNBC vs ERpos)",
    y = NULL,
    shape = "Evidence"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(paths$figures, "15_METABRIC_focused_ERpos_TNBC_axis_signature.png"),
  plot = p_axis,
  width = 8.5,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

# ----------------------------
# 15F — Weighted vs unweighted consistency plot
# ----------------------------

p_consistency <- ggplot(
  consistency_tbl,
  aes(x = cliffs_delta, y = axis, fill = score_type)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
  labs(
    title = "METABRIC validation: weighted vs unweighted consistency",
    subtitle = "Positive values indicate higher TNBC activity",
    x = "Cliff's delta (TNBC vs ERpos)",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Score type"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(paths$figures, "15_METABRIC_weighted_unweighted_axis_consistency.png"),
  plot = p_consistency,
  width = 8.5,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

message("Chunk 15 completed: METABRIC focused ERpos/TNBC axis signature.")
print(axis_stats_w)
```

```{r Chunk 16 — METABRIC downsampling robustness of ERpos vs TNBC axis signature}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 16 — METABRIC downsampling robustness of ERpos vs TNBC axis signature
# Purpose:
#   Test whether ERpos/TNBC axis differences remain stable when ERpos is
#   repeatedly downsampled to TNBC sample size.
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

set.seed(SPEC$seed)

scores_w_focus <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_weighted_focused_labeled.rds"))
AXES_ORDER <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "10_axes_order.rds"))

cliffs_delta_manual <- function(x_tnbc, x_erpos) {
  x_tnbc <- x_tnbc[is.finite(x_tnbc)]
  x_erpos <- x_erpos[is.finite(x_erpos)]
  if (length(x_tnbc) == 0 || length(x_erpos) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  cmp <- outer(x_tnbc, x_erpos, "-")
  (sum(cmp > 0) - sum(cmp < 0)) / (length(x_tnbc) * length(x_erpos))
}

focus_long <- scores_w_focus %>%
  mutate(
    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC = factor(
      as.character(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC),
      levels = c("ERpos", "TNBC")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(sample_id, focused_group_ERpos_TNBC, all_of(AXES_ORDER)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(AXES_ORDER),
    names_to = "axis",
    values_to = "axis_score"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC), is.finite(axis_score))

n_erpos <- sum(scores_w_focus$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos", na.rm = TRUE)
n_tnbc  <- sum(scores_w_focus$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC", na.rm = TRUE)

message("ERpos n = ", n_erpos)
message("TNBC n = ", n_tnbc)
message("Downsampling ERpos to TNBC size; B = ", SPEC$B_downsample)

stopifnot(n_erpos > n_tnbc)
stopifnot(n_tnbc > 20)

erpos_ids <- scores_w_focus %>%
  filter(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos") %>%
  pull(sample_id)

tnbc_ids <- scores_w_focus %>%
  filter(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC") %>%
  pull(sample_id)

downsample_results <- lapply(seq_len(SPEC$B_downsample), function(b) {

  sampled_erpos <- sample(erpos_ids, size = length(tnbc_ids), replace = FALSE)

  focus_long %>%
    filter(sample_id %in% c(sampled_erpos, tnbc_ids)) %>%
    group_by(axis) %>%
    summarise(
      iter = b,
      cliffs_delta = cliffs_delta_manual(
        axis_score[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"],
        axis_score[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"]
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

robust_summary <- downsample_results %>%
  group_by(axis) %>%
  summarise(
    B = n(),
    median_delta = median(cliffs_delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    q025 = quantile(cliffs_delta, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    q975 = quantile(cliffs_delta, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_same_positive = mean(cliffs_delta > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_same_negative = mean(cliffs_delta < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    robustness = case_when(
      abs(median_delta) >= 0.30 & (q025 > 0 | q975 < 0) ~ "Strong",
      abs(median_delta) >= 0.15 & (q025 > 0 | q975 < 0) ~ "Moderate",
      TRUE ~ "Weak"
    ),
    axis = factor(axis, levels = AXES_ORDER)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(median_delta))

readr::write_csv(
  downsample_results,
  file.path(paths$tables, "16_METABRIC_downsampling_all_iterations.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  robust_summary,
  file.path(paths$tables, "16_METABRIC_downsampling_robustness_summary.csv")
)

p_down <- robust_summary %>%
  mutate(
    axis = factor(axis, levels = rev(axis)),
    robustness = factor(robustness, levels = c("Strong", "Moderate", "Weak"))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = median_delta, y = axis, shape = robustness)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = q025, xmax = q975), height = 0.18, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 3.2) +
  labs(
    title = "METABRIC validation: downsampling robustness of ERpos vs TNBC ferroptosis signature",
    subtitle = paste0("ERpos repeatedly downsampled to TNBC size; B = ", SPEC$B_downsample),
    x = "Median Cliff's delta across downsampling runs",
    y = NULL,
    shape = "Robustness"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(paths$figures, "16_METABRIC_downsampling_robustness_ERpos_TNBC.png"),
  plot = p_down,
  width = 8.5,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

message("Chunk 16 completed: METABRIC downsampling robustness.")
print(robust_summary)

p_down
```

```{r Chunk 17 — METABRIC axis–axis wiring matrices}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 17 — METABRIC axis–axis wiring matrices
# Pipeline:
#   Axis score → marker genes → wiring → robustness → validation
#
# Purpose:
#   Build ERpos and TNBC ferroptosis axis–axis correlation matrices.
#   Then calculate differential wiring:
#     Delta rho = rho_TNBC - rho_ERpos
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

scores_w_focus <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_weighted_focused_labeled.rds"))
AXES_ORDER <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "10_axes_order.rds"))

# ----------------------------
# 17A — Prepare focused score matrix
# ----------------------------

scores_focus <- scores_w_focus %>%
  mutate(
    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC = factor(
      as.character(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC),
      levels = c("ERpos", "TNBC")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC))

stopifnot(all(AXES_ORDER %in% names(scores_focus)))

# ----------------------------
# 17B — Correlation helper
# ----------------------------

make_axis_cor <- function(df, group_label) {

  mat <- df %>%
    filter(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == group_label) %>%
    select(all_of(AXES_ORDER)) %>%
    as.matrix()

  rho <- cor(
    mat,
    method = "spearman",
    use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
  )

  rho <- rho[AXES_ORDER, AXES_ORDER]

  rho
}

rho_erpos <- make_axis_cor(scores_focus, "ERpos")
rho_tnbc  <- make_axis_cor(scores_focus, "TNBC")

delta_rho <- rho_tnbc - rho_erpos

diag(delta_rho) <- 0

# ----------------------------
# 17C — Long edge tables
# ----------------------------

mat_to_long <- function(mat, value_name) {
  as.data.frame(as.table(mat)) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    rename(
      axis_1 = Var1,
      axis_2 = Var2,
      value = Freq
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      axis_1 = as.character(axis_1),
      axis_2 = as.character(axis_2)
    ) %>%
    rename(!!value_name := value)
}

rho_erpos_long <- mat_to_long(rho_erpos, "rho_ERpos")
rho_tnbc_long  <- mat_to_long(rho_tnbc, "rho_TNBC")
delta_long     <- mat_to_long(delta_rho, "delta_rho")

edge_tbl <- rho_erpos_long %>%
  left_join(rho_tnbc_long, by = c("axis_1", "axis_2")) %>%
  left_join(delta_long, by = c("axis_1", "axis_2")) %>%
  mutate(
    abs_delta_rho = abs(delta_rho),
    stronger_group = case_when(
      delta_rho > 0 ~ "Stronger_in_TNBC",
      delta_rho < 0 ~ "Stronger_in_ERpos",
      TRUE ~ "No_difference"
    )
  )

edge_tbl_upper <- edge_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    axis_1_i = match(axis_1, AXES_ORDER),
    axis_2_i = match(axis_2, AXES_ORDER)
  ) %>%
  filter(axis_1_i < axis_2_i) %>%
  select(-axis_1_i, -axis_2_i) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_delta_rho))

# ----------------------------
# 17D — QC summary
# ----------------------------

qc_wiring <- tibble(
  dataset = project$dataset,
  cohort = "METABRIC_Focused_ERpos_TNBC",
  n_ERpos = sum(scores_focus$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"),
  n_TNBC  = sum(scores_focus$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"),
  n_axes = length(AXES_ORDER),
  n_unique_edges = nrow(edge_tbl_upper),
  threshold_abs_r = SPEC$thr_abs_r,
  n_ERpos_edges_abs_r_ge_threshold = sum(abs(edge_tbl_upper$rho_ERpos) >= SPEC$thr_abs_r, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_TNBC_edges_abs_r_ge_threshold  = sum(abs(edge_tbl_upper$rho_TNBC) >= SPEC$thr_abs_r, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_delta_edges_abs_delta_ge_threshold = sum(abs(edge_tbl_upper$delta_rho) >= SPEC$thr_abs_r, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# ----------------------------
# 17E — Save matrices and tables
# ----------------------------

saveRDS(rho_erpos, file.path(paths$processed, "17_axis_cor_ERpos_METABRIC.rds"))
saveRDS(rho_tnbc,  file.path(paths$processed, "17_axis_cor_TNBC_METABRIC.rds"))
saveRDS(delta_rho, file.path(paths$processed, "17_axis_cor_delta_TNBC_minus_ERpos_METABRIC.rds"))

readr::write_csv(edge_tbl, file.path(paths$tables, "17_METABRIC_axis_wiring_all_edges_full_matrix.csv"))
readr::write_csv(edge_tbl_upper, file.path(paths$tables, "17_METABRIC_axis_wiring_unique_edges.csv"))
readr::write_csv(qc_wiring, file.path(paths$tables, "17_METABRIC_axis_wiring_QC.csv"))

# ----------------------------
# 17F — Heatmap plotting helper
# ----------------------------

plot_cor_heatmap <- function(mat, title, legend_title, fill_limits = c(-1, 1)) {

  df <- mat_to_long(mat, "rho") %>%
    mutate(
      axis_1 = factor(axis_1, levels = rev(AXES_ORDER)),
      axis_2 = factor(axis_2, levels = AXES_ORDER)
    )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = axis_2, y = axis_1, fill = rho)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", rho)), size = 3.4) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#2166AC",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#B2182B",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = fill_limits,
      name = legend_title
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
}

p_erpos <- plot_cor_heatmap(
  rho_erpos,
  title = "METABRIC ERpos ferroptosis wiring",
  legend_title = "Spearman\nrho",
  fill_limits = c(-1, 1)
)

p_tnbc <- plot_cor_heatmap(
  rho_tnbc,
  title = "METABRIC TNBC ferroptosis wiring",
  legend_title = "Spearman\nrho",
  fill_limits = c(-1, 1)
)

p_delta <- plot_cor_heatmap(
  delta_rho,
  title = "METABRIC differential ferroptosis wiring",
  legend_title = "Delta rho\nTNBC-ERpos",
  fill_limits = c(-0.5, 0.5)
)

# ----------------------------
# 17G — Save figures
# ----------------------------

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "17_METABRIC_ERpos_axis_wiring_heatmap.png"),
  p_erpos,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "17_METABRIC_TNBC_axis_wiring_heatmap.png"),
  p_tnbc,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "17_METABRIC_delta_axis_wiring_TNBC_minus_ERpos_heatmap.png"),
  p_delta,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

message("Chunk 17 completed: METABRIC axis–axis wiring matrices.")
print(qc_wiring)
print(edge_tbl_upper)

p_erpos
p_tnbc
p_delta

```

```{r Chunk 18 — METABRIC wiring network visualization FINAL}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 18 — METABRIC wiring network visualization FINAL
# Fixes:
#   - removes crowded legends from two-panel network
#   - keeps labels readable
#   - saves clean publication-ready figures
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
})

AXES_ORDER <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "10_axes_order.rds"))

rho_erpos <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "17_axis_cor_ERpos_METABRIC.rds"))
rho_tnbc  <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "17_axis_cor_TNBC_METABRIC.rds"))
delta_rho <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "17_axis_cor_delta_TNBC_minus_ERpos_METABRIC.rds"))

thr <- SPEC$thr_abs_r

axis_labels <- c(
  Xc_GSH = "Xc/GSH",
  GPX4_Selenium = "GPX4/Se",
  FSP1_CoQ = "FSP1/CoQ",
  BH4_GCH1 = "BH4/GCH1",
  DHODH_Mito = "DHODH",
  Iron_Handling = "Iron",
  PUFA_Loading = "PUFA",
  Lipid_Peroxidation = "Lipid\nPeroxidation"
)

axis_class <- c(
  Xc_GSH = "Defense",
  GPX4_Selenium = "Defense",
  FSP1_CoQ = "Defense",
  BH4_GCH1 = "Defense",
  DHODH_Mito = "Defense",
  Iron_Handling = "Susceptibility",
  PUFA_Loading = "Susceptibility",
  Lipid_Peroxidation = "Susceptibility"
)

node_pos <- tibble::tibble(
  axis = AXES_ORDER,
  label = axis_labels[AXES_ORDER],
  axis_class = axis_class[AXES_ORDER],
  x = c(1.05, 0.65, 0.30, 0.10, 0.30, 0.75, 1.05, 1.25),
  y = c(0.75, 1.05, 0.75, 0.30, 0.00, -0.15, 0.05, 0.35)
)

mat_to_edges <- function(mat, value_name = "rho") {
  as.data.frame(as.table(mat)) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    rename(axis_1 = Var1, axis_2 = Var2, value = Freq) %>%
    mutate(
      axis_1 = as.character(axis_1),
      axis_2 = as.character(axis_2),
      i = match(axis_1, AXES_ORDER),
      j = match(axis_2, AXES_ORDER)
    ) %>%
    filter(i < j) %>%
    rename(!!value_name := value) %>%
    select(axis_1, axis_2, all_of(value_name))
}

make_network_edges <- function(mat, value_name = "rho") {
  mat_to_edges(mat, value_name) %>%
    filter(abs(.data[[value_name]]) >= thr) %>%
    left_join(node_pos %>% select(axis, x1 = x, y1 = y), by = c("axis_1" = "axis")) %>%
    left_join(node_pos %>% select(axis, x2 = x, y2 = y), by = c("axis_2" = "axis")) %>%
    mutate(
      edge_abs = abs(.data[[value_name]]),
      edge_sign = ifelse(.data[[value_name]] >= 0, "Positive", "Negative")
    )
}

edges_erpos <- make_network_edges(rho_erpos, "rho")
edges_tnbc  <- make_network_edges(rho_tnbc, "rho")

edges_delta <- mat_to_edges(delta_rho, "delta_rho") %>%
  filter(abs(delta_rho) >= thr) %>%
  left_join(node_pos %>% select(axis, x1 = x, y1 = y), by = c("axis_1" = "axis")) %>%
  left_join(node_pos %>% select(axis, x2 = x, y2 = y), by = c("axis_2" = "axis")) %>%
  mutate(
    edge_abs = abs(delta_rho),
    stronger = ifelse(delta_rho > 0, "Stronger in TNBC", "Stronger in ERpos")
  )

plot_network <- function(edges, title, subtitle) {

  ggplot() +
    geom_segment(
      data = edges,
      aes(
        x = x1, y = y1,
        xend = x2, yend = y2,
        linewidth = edge_abs,
        linetype = edge_sign
      ),
      color = "#C43E52",
      alpha = 0.88,
      lineend = "round",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = node_pos,
      aes(x = x, y = y, fill = axis_class),
      shape = 21,
      size = 7.2,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.6,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = node_pos,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 5.1,
      lineheight = 0.90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_linewidth(range = c(0.5, 4.0)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Positive = "solid", Negative = "dashed")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Defense = "#8DD3C7", Susceptibility = "#FDB462")) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(-0.15, 1.55),
      ylim = c(-0.40, 1.25),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle) +
    theme_void(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.margin = margin(45, 65, 45, 65)
    )
}

p_erpos_net <- plot_network(
  edges_erpos,
  "METABRIC ERpos ferroptosis wiring",
  paste0("Edges shown if |rho| ≥ ", thr)
)

p_tnbc_net <- plot_network(
  edges_tnbc,
  "METABRIC TNBC ferroptosis wiring",
  paste0("Edges shown if |rho| ≥ ", thr)
)

p_pair <- p_erpos_net + p_tnbc_net +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "METABRIC validation: ferroptosis axis wiring differs between ERpos and TNBC",
    subtitle = "Matched layout; thicker red edges indicate stronger Spearman coupling. Solid = positive correlation; dashed = negative correlation. Teal nodes = defense axes; orange nodes = susceptibility axes.",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 21),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
      plot.margin = margin(25, 35, 25, 35)
    )
  )

plot_delta_network <- function(edges) {

  ggplot() +
    geom_segment(
      data = edges,
      aes(
        x = x1, y = y1,
        xend = x2, yend = y2,
        linewidth = edge_abs,
        linetype = stronger
      ),
      color = "#C43E52",
      alpha = 0.90,
      lineend = "round"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = node_pos,
      aes(x = x, y = y, fill = axis_class),
      shape = 21,
      size = 7.8,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = node_pos,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 5.5,
      lineheight = 0.90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_linewidth(range = c(0.6, 4.5), name = "|Delta rho|") +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("Stronger in TNBC" = "solid", "Stronger in ERpos" = "dashed"),
      name = "Differential wiring"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(Defense = "#8DD3C7", Susceptibility = "#FDB462"),
      name = "Axis class"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(-0.15, 1.55),
      ylim = c(-0.40, 1.28),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "METABRIC validation: differential ferroptosis wiring",
      subtitle = paste0("Edges shown if |Delta rho| ≥ ", thr, "; Delta rho = TNBC − ERpos")
    ) +
    theme_void(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.margin = margin(60, 75, 75, 75)
    )
}

p_delta_net <- plot_delta_network(edges_delta)

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "18_METABRIC_ERpos_TNBC_matched_wiring_networks.png"),
  p_pair,
  width = 20,
  height = 10.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "18_METABRIC_differential_wiring_network.png"),
  p_delta_net,
  width = 11.5,
  height = 9.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

readr::write_csv(edges_erpos, file.path(paths$tables, "18_METABRIC_ERpos_network_edges.csv"))
readr::write_csv(edges_tnbc, file.path(paths$tables, "18_METABRIC_TNBC_network_edges.csv"))
readr::write_csv(edges_delta, file.path(paths$tables, "18_METABRIC_differential_network_edges.csv"))

message("Chunk 18 completed: METABRIC wiring network visualizations saved.")

p_pair
p_delta_net
```
