```{r Chunk 19 — METABRIC permutation test for differential ferroptosis wiring }
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 19 — METABRIC permutation test for differential ferroptosis wiring
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
})

set.seed(SPEC$seed)

scores_w_focus <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_weighted_focused_labeled.rds"))
AXES_ORDER <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "10_axes_order.rds"))

rho_erpos_obs <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "17_axis_cor_ERpos_METABRIC.rds"))
rho_tnbc_obs  <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "17_axis_cor_TNBC_METABRIC.rds"))

# ----------------------------
# 19A — Prepare matrix + labels
# ----------------------------

df <- scores_w_focus %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC = factor(
      as.character(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC),
      levels = c("ERpos", "TNBC")
    )
  )

stopifnot(all(AXES_ORDER %in% names(df)))

score_mat <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(AXES_ORDER)) %>%
  as.matrix()

group <- df$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC

n_erpos <- sum(group == "ERpos")
n_tnbc  <- sum(group == "TNBC")

stopifnot(n_erpos > 20, n_tnbc > 20)

# ----------------------------
# 19B — Helper functions
# ----------------------------

calc_delta_mat <- function(mat, grp) {

  rho_er <- stats::cor(
    mat[grp == "ERpos", , drop = FALSE],
    method = "spearman",
    use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
  )

  rho_tn <- stats::cor(
    mat[grp == "TNBC", , drop = FALSE],
    method = "spearman",
    use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
  )

  delta <- rho_tn - rho_er
  diag(delta) <- 0

  delta[AXES_ORDER, AXES_ORDER, drop = FALSE]
}

mat_to_upper <- function(mat, value_name = "value") {

  as.data.frame(as.table(mat)) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::rename(axis_1 = Var1, axis_2 = Var2, value = Freq) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      axis_1 = as.character(axis_1),
      axis_2 = as.character(axis_2),
      i = match(axis_1, AXES_ORDER),
      j = match(axis_2, AXES_ORDER)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(i < j) %>%
    dplyr::select(axis_1, axis_2, value) %>%
    dplyr::rename(!!value_name := value)
}

# ----------------------------
# 19C — Observed delta rho
# ----------------------------

delta_obs <- rho_tnbc_obs - rho_erpos_obs
diag(delta_obs) <- 0
delta_obs <- delta_obs[AXES_ORDER, AXES_ORDER, drop = FALSE]

obs_edges <- mat_to_upper(delta_obs, "delta_rho") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(mat_to_upper(rho_erpos_obs, "rho_ERpos"), by = c("axis_1", "axis_2")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(mat_to_upper(rho_tnbc_obs, "rho_TNBC"), by = c("axis_1", "axis_2")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    abs_delta_rho = abs(delta_rho),
    edge = paste(axis_1, axis_2, sep = "–"),
    direction = dplyr::case_when(
      delta_rho > 0 ~ "Stronger_in_TNBC",
      delta_rho < 0 ~ "Stronger_in_ERpos",
      TRUE ~ "No_difference"
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# 19D — Permutation test
# ----------------------------

message("Running METABRIC wiring permutation test; B = ", SPEC$B_perm)

perm_delta_list <- vector("list", SPEC$B_perm)

for (b in seq_len(SPEC$B_perm)) {

  perm_group <- sample(group, replace = FALSE)
  perm_delta <- calc_delta_mat(score_mat, perm_group)

  perm_delta_list[[b]] <- mat_to_upper(perm_delta, "perm_delta_rho") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(iter = b)

  if (b %% 200 == 0) {
    message("Completed permutation ", b, " / ", SPEC$B_perm)
  }
}

perm_edges <- dplyr::bind_rows(perm_delta_list)

perm_summary <- perm_edges %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    obs_edges %>% dplyr::select(axis_1, axis_2, delta_rho),
    by = c("axis_1", "axis_2")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(axis_1, axis_2) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    B = dplyr::n(),
    observed_delta_rho = delta_rho[1],
    empirical_p = (
      sum(abs(perm_delta_rho) >= abs(delta_rho[1]), na.rm = TRUE) + 1
    ) / (dplyr::n() + 1),
    perm_mean = mean(perm_delta_rho, na.rm = TRUE),
    perm_sd = sd(perm_delta_rho, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    empirical_FDR = p.adjust(empirical_p, method = "BH")
  )

perm_results <- obs_edges %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    perm_summary,
    by = c("axis_1", "axis_2")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(empirical_FDR, dplyr::desc(abs_delta_rho))

# ----------------------------
# 19E — Save outputs
# ----------------------------

saveRDS(
  perm_results,
  file.path(paths$processed, "19_METABRIC_wiring_permutation_results.rds")
)

readr::write_csv(
  perm_results,
  file.path(paths$tables, "19_METABRIC_wiring_permutation_results.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  perm_edges,
  file.path(paths$tables, "19_METABRIC_wiring_permutation_all_iterations.csv")
)

# ----------------------------
# 19F — Volcano-style plot
# ----------------------------

p_perm <- perm_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    neg_log10_FDR = -log10(empirical_FDR),
    significant = empirical_FDR < 0.05
  ) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = delta_rho,
      y = neg_log10_FDR,
      label = edge
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(size = abs_delta_rho, shape = significant),
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = perm_results %>%
      dplyr::mutate(neg_log10_FDR = -log10(empirical_FDR)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(empirical_FDR < 0.10 | abs_delta_rho >= 0.35),
    max.overlaps = 30,
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "METABRIC permutation test: differential ferroptosis wiring",
    subtitle = "Observed delta rho = rho_TNBC - rho_ERpos; empirical BH-FDR from label permutations",
    x = expression(Delta~rho~"(TNBC - ERpos)"),
    y = expression(-log[10]~"(empirical FDR)"),
    size = expression(abs(Delta~rho)),
    shape = "FDR < 0.05"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11)
  )

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(paths$figures, "19_METABRIC_wiring_permutation_volcano.png"),
  plot = p_perm,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

message("Chunk 19 completed: permutation results saved.")
print(perm_results)

p_perm
```

```{r Chunk 20 — Export final METABRIC validation evidence summary}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 20 — Export final METABRIC validation evidence summary
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
})

# ----------------------------
# 20A — Load key outputs
# ----------------------------

axis_stats <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "15_METABRIC_focused_ERpos_TNBC_axis_statistics_weighted.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

downsample <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "16_METABRIC_downsampling_robustness_summary.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

perm_wiring <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "19_METABRIC_wiring_permutation_results.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

AXES_ORDER <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "10_axes_order.rds"))

# Standardize possible Chunk 19 column names
perm_wiring <- perm_wiring %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(~ stringr::str_replace_all(.x, "empirical_FDR", "empirical_fdr"))

# ----------------------------
# 20B — Axis-level validation summary
# ----------------------------

axis_validation_summary <- axis_stats %>%
  dplyr::select(
    axis,
    n_ERpos,
    n_TNBC,
    median_ERpos,
    median_TNBC,
    delta_median,
    cliffs_delta,
    wilcox_p,
    wilcox_fdr,
    evidence,
    direction
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    downsample %>%
      dplyr::select(
        axis,
        downsample_median_delta = median_delta,
        downsample_q025 = q025,
        downsample_q975 = q975,
        downsample_robustness = robustness
      ),
    by = "axis"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    validation_call = dplyr::case_when(
      wilcox_fdr < 0.05 &
        abs(cliffs_delta) >= 0.30 &
        downsample_robustness == "Strong" ~ "Strong_axis_validation",

      wilcox_fdr < 0.05 &
        abs(cliffs_delta) >= 0.15 &
        downsample_robustness %in% c("Strong", "Moderate") ~ "Moderate_axis_validation",

      TRUE ~ "Weak_or_not_validated"
    ),
    axis = factor(axis, levels = AXES_ORDER)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(axis)

# ----------------------------
# 20C — Wiring-level validation summary
# ----------------------------

wiring_validation_summary <- perm_wiring %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    wiring_validation_call = dplyr::case_when(
      empirical_fdr < 0.05 & abs_delta_rho >= 0.30 ~ "Strong_wiring_validation",
      empirical_fdr < 0.05 & abs_delta_rho >= 0.15 ~ "Moderate_wiring_validation",
      TRUE ~ "Weak_or_not_validated"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(empirical_fdr, dplyr::desc(abs_delta_rho))

# ----------------------------
# 20D — Axis involvement in significant wiring
# ----------------------------

axis_wiring_support <- wiring_validation_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(empirical_fdr < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::select(axis_1, axis_2, delta_rho, empirical_fdr) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(axis_1, axis_2),
    names_to = "axis_position",
    values_to = "axis"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(axis) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_FDR_significant_wiring_edges = dplyr::n(),
    mean_abs_delta_rho_involved_edges = mean(abs(delta_rho), na.rm = TRUE),
    strongest_wiring_fdr = min(empirical_fdr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

axis_validation_summary <- axis_validation_summary %>%
  dplyr::left_join(axis_wiring_support, by = "axis") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_FDR_significant_wiring_edges = ifelse(
      is.na(n_FDR_significant_wiring_edges),
      0,
      n_FDR_significant_wiring_edges
    ),
    mean_abs_delta_rho_involved_edges = ifelse(
      is.na(mean_abs_delta_rho_involved_edges),
      NA_real_,
      mean_abs_delta_rho_involved_edges
    ),
    strongest_wiring_fdr = ifelse(
      is.na(strongest_wiring_fdr),
      NA_real_,
      strongest_wiring_fdr
    )
  )

# ----------------------------
# 20E — Save tables
# ----------------------------

readr::write_csv(
  axis_validation_summary,
  file.path(paths$tables, "20_METABRIC_axis_validation_summary.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  wiring_validation_summary,
  file.path(paths$tables, "20_METABRIC_wiring_validation_summary.csv")
)

# ----------------------------
# 20F — Plain-language validation note
# ----------------------------

top_tnbc_axes <- axis_validation_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(direction == "Higher_in_TNBC", validation_call != "Weak_or_not_validated") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(cliffs_delta)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(axis)

top_erpos_axes <- axis_validation_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(direction == "Higher_in_ERpos", validation_call != "Weak_or_not_validated") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cliffs_delta) %>%
  dplyr::pull(axis)

sig_wiring_n <- sum(wiring_validation_summary$empirical_fdr < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

sig_wiring_tnbc_n <- sum(
  wiring_validation_summary$empirical_fdr < 0.05 &
    wiring_validation_summary$delta_rho > 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

note <- c(
  "METABRIC validation evidence summary",
  "",
  paste0("Dataset: ", project$dataset),
  paste0("Role: ", project$role),
  "",
  "Axis-level validation:",
  paste0(
    "TNBC-higher validated axes: ",
    ifelse(length(top_tnbc_axes) > 0, paste(top_tnbc_axes, collapse = "; "), "none")
  ),
  paste0(
    "ERpos-higher validated axes: ",
    ifelse(length(top_erpos_axes) > 0, paste(top_erpos_axes, collapse = "; "), "none")
  ),
  "",
  "Wiring-level validation:",
  paste0("FDR-significant differential wiring edges: ", sig_wiring_n),
  paste0("FDR-significant edges stronger in TNBC: ", sig_wiring_tnbc_n),
  "",
  "Interpretation rule:",
  "METABRIC is used as independent validation of the GSE96058 axis-first and wiring-first framework.",
  "Axis-level evidence supports subtype activity differences.",
  "Wiring evidence supports subtype-specific ferroptosis regulatory architecture."
)

writeLines(
  note,
  con = file.path(paths$manuscript, "20_METABRIC_validation_summary_note.txt")
)

message("Chunk 20 completed: METABRIC validation evidence summary exported.")

print(axis_validation_summary)
print(wiring_validation_summary)

```

```{r Chunk 21 — METABRIC validation of discovery-selected marker genes}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 21 — METABRIC validation of discovery-selected marker genes
# Purpose:
#   Validate GSE96058-selected marker genes in METABRIC.
#
# Rule:
#   Do NOT select markers de novo from METABRIC.
#   METABRIC only tests whether discovery-selected candidates reproduce.
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
})

expr_z <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "11_expr_z_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds"))
clin   <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "09_clin_focused_ERpos_TNBC_repSAFE.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_z) == clin$sample_id))

# ----------------------------
# 21A — Define discovery-selected markers
# ----------------------------
# These must come from GSE96058 discovery, not METABRIC selection.

discovery_markers <- c(
  "DHODH",
  "FADS2",
  "POR",
  "SEPSECS",
  "SLC40A1"
)

marker_axis_map <- tibble::tibble(
  gene = c("DHODH", "FADS2", "POR", "SEPSECS", "SLC40A1"),
  axis = c("DHODH_Mito", "PUFA_Loading", "Lipid_Peroxidation",
           "GPX4_Selenium", "Iron_Handling")
)

missing_markers <- setdiff(discovery_markers, rownames(expr_z))

if (length(missing_markers) > 0) {
  warning("Markers missing in METABRIC expression matrix: ",
          paste(missing_markers, collapse = ", "))
}

markers_present <- intersect(discovery_markers, rownames(expr_z))

stopifnot(length(markers_present) >= 3)

# ----------------------------
# 21B — Manual Cliff's delta
# ----------------------------

cliffs_delta_manual <- function(x_tnbc, x_erpos) {
  x_tnbc <- x_tnbc[is.finite(x_tnbc)]
  x_erpos <- x_erpos[is.finite(x_erpos)]

  if (length(x_tnbc) == 0 || length(x_erpos) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  cmp <- outer(x_tnbc, x_erpos, "-")
  (sum(cmp > 0) - sum(cmp < 0)) / (length(x_tnbc) * length(x_erpos))
}

# ----------------------------
# 21C — Prepare marker expression table
# ----------------------------

marker_df <- as.data.frame(t(expr_z[markers_present, , drop = FALSE]))
marker_df$sample_id <- rownames(marker_df)

marker_long <- marker_df %>%
  left_join(
    clin %>% select(sample_id, focused_group_ERpos_TNBC),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC %in% c("ERpos", "TNBC")) %>%
  mutate(
    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC = factor(
      as.character(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC),
      levels = c("ERpos", "TNBC")
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(markers_present),
    names_to = "gene",
    values_to = "z_expression"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(z_expression)) %>%
  left_join(marker_axis_map, by = "gene")

# ----------------------------
# 21D — Marker-level validation statistics
# ----------------------------

marker_stats <- marker_long %>%
  group_by(gene, axis) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ERpos = sum(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"),
    n_TNBC  = sum(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"),
    median_ERpos = median(z_expression[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"], na.rm = TRUE),
    median_TNBC  = median(z_expression[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"], na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_median = median_TNBC - median_ERpos,
    cliffs_delta = cliffs_delta_manual(
      z_expression[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"],
      z_expression[focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"]
    ),
    wilcox_p = wilcox.test(
      z_expression ~ focused_group_ERpos_TNBC,
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    wilcox_fdr = p.adjust(wilcox_p, method = "BH"),
    direction = case_when(
      cliffs_delta > 0 ~ "Higher_in_TNBC",
      cliffs_delta < 0 ~ "Higher_in_ERpos",
      TRUE ~ "No_direction"
    ),
    validation_evidence = case_when(
      wilcox_fdr < 0.05 & abs(cliffs_delta) >= 0.30 ~ "Strong_marker_validation",
      wilcox_fdr < 0.05 & abs(cliffs_delta) >= 0.15 ~ "Moderate_marker_validation",
      TRUE ~ "Weak_or_not_validated"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(cliffs_delta)))

# ----------------------------
# 21E — Save outputs
# ----------------------------

readr::write_csv(
  marker_long,
  file.path(paths$tables, "21_METABRIC_discovery_marker_expression_long.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  marker_stats,
  file.path(paths$tables, "21_METABRIC_discovery_marker_validation_statistics.csv")
)

writeLines(
  c(
    "Chunk 21 METABRIC marker validation note",
    "",
    "Markers were not selected from METABRIC.",
    "METABRIC was used only to validate marker candidates selected from GSE96058 discovery.",
    "",
    paste0("Discovery-selected markers tested: ", paste(discovery_markers, collapse = ", ")),
    "",
    "Positive Cliff's delta indicates higher expression in TNBC.",
    "Negative Cliff's delta indicates higher expression in ERpos."
  ),
  con = file.path(paths$manuscript, "21_METABRIC_marker_validation_note.txt")
)

message("Chunk 21 completed: METABRIC marker-level validation.")
print(marker_stats)

```


```{r Chunk 22 — METABRIC boxplots of discovery-selected validation markers}
# ----------------------------
# Chunk 22 — METABRIC boxplots of discovery-selected validation markers
# Purpose:
#   Visualize marker-level validation in METABRIC.
#   Uses markers selected from GSE96058 discovery, not METABRIC.
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
})

marker_long <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "21_METABRIC_discovery_marker_expression_long.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

marker_stats <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "21_METABRIC_discovery_marker_validation_statistics.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

gene_order <- marker_stats %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(cliffs_delta))) %>%
  pull(gene)

plot_df <- marker_long %>%
  mutate(
    gene_label = paste0(gene, "\n", axis),
    gene_label = factor(
      gene_label,
      levels = paste0(gene_order, "\n", marker_stats$axis[match(gene_order, marker_stats$gene)])
    ),
    focused_group_ERpos_TNBC = factor(
      focused_group_ERpos_TNBC,
      levels = c("ERpos", "TNBC")
    )
  )

stat_labels <- marker_stats %>%
  mutate(
    gene_label = paste0(gene, "\n", axis),
    label = paste0(
      "FDR=", signif(wilcox_fdr, 2),
      "\nΔ=", round(cliffs_delta, 2)
    )
  )

p_marker_box <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(x = focused_group_ERpos_TNBC, y = z_expression, fill = focused_group_ERpos_TNBC)
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.80, linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.18, alpha = 0.18, size = 0.55, color = "black") +
  geom_text(
    data = stat_labels,
    aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 1.25,
    size = 3.7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("ERpos" = "#F8766D", "TNBC" = "#00BFC4")) +
  labs(
    title = "METABRIC validation of GSE96058-selected ferroptosis markers",
    subtitle = "Markers were selected in discovery and tested independently in METABRIC; Δ = Cliff's delta, positive values indicate higher TNBC expression",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Gene expression (Z-score)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(paths$figures, "22_METABRIC_discovery_marker_validation_boxplots.png"),
  plot = p_marker_box,
  width = 12,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

message("Chunk 22 completed: METABRIC discovery-marker validation boxplots saved.")
p_marker_box
```

```{r Chunk 23 — Cross-cohort marker validation summary}
# Chunk 23 — Cross-cohort marker validation summary
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(tibble)
})

paths_discovery <- list(
  tables = file.path(root, "GSE96058", "03_results", "tables")
)

disc_stats <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths_discovery$tables, "22_unbiased_selected_marker_expression_statistics.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename(
    delta_disc = cliffs_delta_TNBC_vs_ERpos,
    fdr_disc   = FDR_BH
  )

val_stats <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(paths$tables, "21_METABRIC_discovery_marker_validation_statistics.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename(
    delta_val = cliffs_delta,
    fdr_val   = wilcox_fdr
  )

cross_validation <- disc_stats %>%
  select(gene, axis, delta_disc, fdr_disc) %>%
  inner_join(
    val_stats %>% select(gene, delta_val, fdr_val),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    direction_disc = ifelse(delta_disc > 0, "Higher_in_TNBC", "Higher_in_ERpos"),
    direction_val  = ifelse(delta_val > 0, "Higher_in_TNBC", "Higher_in_ERpos"),
    concordant_direction = direction_disc == direction_val,
    validation_strength = case_when(
      fdr_disc < 0.05 & fdr_val < 0.05 & concordant_direction ~ "Strong_replicated",
      concordant_direction ~ "Directional_consistent",
      TRUE ~ "Discordant"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(delta_val)))

readr::write_csv(
  cross_validation,
  file.path(paths$tables, "23_cross_cohort_marker_validation.csv")
)
```

```{r Chunk 24 — METABRIC overall survival analysis — FULLY UPDATED}

# ----------------------------
# Chunk 24 — METABRIC overall survival analysis (FULLY UPDATED)
#
# KEY CHANGES FROM PREVIOUS VERSION:
#
#   FRAMING: All survival analyses are now explicitly pre-specified
#   as hypothesis-generating exploratory analyses, not powered for
#   independent prognostic discovery. This framing is set in 24A
#   and carried through all summary outputs.
#
#   24K  (unchanged): Subtype-stratified KM for GPX4/Selenium only
#         — retained for compatibility with existing figure S7B.
#
#   24K2 (NEW): Subtype-stratified log-rank + Cox for ALL 8 axes
#         within ERpos and TNBC separately. Results saved as
#         Supplementary Table S7C. Addresses reviewer question:
#         "If subtype composition confounds GPX4/Selenium, why not
#          check all eight axes?"
#
#   24K3 (NEW): Subtype-stratified KM panel figures (Supp Fig S7C).
#         ERpos and TNBC panels saved separately per axis.
#
#   24K4 (NEW): Subtype-stratified HR forest plot across all axes
#         for both ERpos and TNBC (Supp Fig S7D).
#
#   24L/24M: Unchanged — univariable and multivariable forest plots.
#
#   24N  (updated): Summary note now includes exploratory framing
#         and references the new supplementary table.
#
# OUTPUT FILES (new):
#   tables/24c_METABRIC_survival_subtype_stratified_all_axes.csv
#   figures/24_METABRIC_KM_subtype_stratified_[AXIS]_ERpos.png
#   figures/24_METABRIC_KM_subtype_stratified_[AXIS]_TNBC.png
#   figures/24_METABRIC_survival_subtype_stratified_HR_forest.png
# ----------------------------

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(purrr)
})

# ----------------------------
# 24A — Survival packages + EXPLORATORY FRAMING STATEMENT
# ----------------------------

surv_pkgs <- c("survival", "survminer", "gridExtra", "grid")
need <- surv_pkgs[!surv_pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages())]
if (length(need) > 0) install.packages(need)
invisible(lapply(surv_pkgs, library, character.only = TRUE))

# Write the pre-analysis framing statement to the manuscript folder.
# This is a citable audit trail that the survival analyses were designed
# as exploratory, not powered for independent prognostic discovery.

writeLines(
  c(
    "CHUNK 24 — PRE-ANALYSIS FRAMING STATEMENT",
    "",
    "Survival analyses in METABRIC were conducted as pre-specified",
    "exploratory analyses to assess whether ferroptosis axis scores show",
    "directional alignment with clinical outcomes consistent with the",
    "biological states identified in the transcriptomic analyses.",
    "",
    "These analyses were NOT powered to detect independent prognostic",
    "effects after FDR correction across eight axes in a mixed-subtype cohort.",
    "An adequately powered subtype-stratified survival study would require",
    "approximately 400-600 patients within a single subtype (e.g., TNBC-only)",
    "with complete covariate data, substantially larger than the TNBC-annotated",
    "subset in METABRIC (n = 201 with OS events available).",
    "",
    "All survival findings are presented as hypothesis-generating and",
    "directionally informative. They should not be interpreted as establishing",
    "prognostic utility without independent prospective validation.",
    "",
    "This framing was pre-specified before any survival models were run."
  ),
  con = file.path(paths$manuscript,
                  "24_survival_analysis_pre_analysis_framing_statement.txt")
)

message("Exploratory framing statement written to manuscript folder.")

# ----------------------------
# 24B — Load scores + join OS columns from full clinical table
# ----------------------------

scores_w_pam50 <- readRDS(
  file.path(paths$processed, "13_scores_weighted_PAM50_labeled.rds")
)

AXES_ORDER <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "10_axes_order.rds"))

clin_full <- readRDS(file.path(paths$processed, "06_clin_aligned.rds")) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

message("Full clinical columns available:")
print(names(clin_full))

# ----------------------------
# 24C — Detect and parse OS columns
# ----------------------------

parse_os_status <- function(x) {
  x_raw <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  dplyr::case_when(
    x_raw %in% c("1", "deceased", "1:deceased", "dead", "true")  ~ 1L,
    x_raw %in% c("0", "living",  "0:living",  "alive", "false") ~ 0L,
    TRUE ~ NA_integer_
  )
}

pick_col <- function(candidates, pool) {
  hit <- intersect(candidates, pool)
  if (length(hit) == 0) NA_character_ else hit[1]
}

os_time_col <- pick_col(
  c("OS_MONTHS", "os_months", "overall_survival_months",
    "OS.MONTHS", "Overall.Survival..Months.", "OS_months"),
  names(clin_full)
)

os_status_col <- pick_col(
  c("OS_STATUS", "os_status", "overall_survival_status",
    "OS.STATUS", "Overall.Survival.Status", "OS_status",
    "Vital.Status", "VITAL_STATUS"),
  names(clin_full)
)

if (is.na(os_time_col) || is.na(os_status_col)) {
  stop(
    "Could not find OS columns.\nAvailable: ",
    paste(names(clin_full), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

message("OS time column:   '", os_time_col,   "'")
message("OS status column: '", os_status_col, "'")

scores_w_pam50 <- scores_w_pam50 %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    clin_full %>%
      dplyr::select(
        sample_id,
        OS_MONTHS = !!rlang::sym(os_time_col),
        OS_STATUS = !!rlang::sym(os_status_col)
      ),
    by = "sample_id"
  )

# ----------------------------
# 24D — Build survival dataset
# ----------------------------

surv_df <- scores_w_pam50 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    os_time   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(OS_MONTHS)),
    os_status = parse_os_status(OS_STATUS)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(os_time),
    os_time > 0,
    !is.na(os_status),
    !is.na(pam50_simple)
  )

n_survival_samples <- nrow(surv_df)
n_events           <- sum(surv_df$os_status == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
median_os          <- median(surv_df$os_time, na.rm = TRUE)

message("Survival cohort: n = ", n_survival_samples,
        " | events = ", n_events,
        " | median OS = ", round(median_os, 1), " months")

stopifnot(n_survival_samples > 200, n_events > 50)

readr::write_csv(
  tibble::tibble(
    dataset            = project$dataset,
    analysis_type      = "pre-specified exploratory (hypothesis-generating)",
    n_survival_samples = n_survival_samples,
    n_events           = n_events,
    median_os_months   = round(median_os, 1),
    note = paste0(
      "Survival analyses are hypothesis-generating. ",
      "Not powered for FDR-significant prognostic discovery in mixed-subtype cohort. ",
      "Subtype-stratified analyses provided in Table S7C as pre-specified sensitivity check."
    )
  ),
  file.path(paths$tables, "24_METABRIC_survival_QC.csv")
)

# ----------------------------
# 24E — Median-split stratification (all axes)
# ----------------------------

for (ax in AXES_ORDER) {
  med_val <- median(surv_df[[ax]], na.rm = TRUE)
  surv_df[[paste0(ax, "_group")]] <- factor(
    ifelse(surv_df[[ax]] >= med_val, "High", "Low"),
    levels = c("Low", "High")
  )
}

# Also build focused ERpos/TNBC subsets for stratified analyses (24K2)
surv_df_erpos <- surv_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos")

surv_df_tnbc  <- surv_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC")

message("ERpos survival subset: n = ", nrow(surv_df_erpos),
        " | events = ", sum(surv_df_erpos$os_status == 1))
message("TNBC survival subset:  n = ", nrow(surv_df_tnbc),
        " | events = ", sum(surv_df_tnbc$os_status == 1))

# Re-compute within-subtype median splits
for (ax in AXES_ORDER) {
  med_erpos <- median(surv_df_erpos[[ax]], na.rm = TRUE)
  med_tnbc  <- median(surv_df_tnbc[[ax]],  na.rm = TRUE)
  surv_df_erpos[[paste0(ax, "_group")]] <- factor(
    ifelse(surv_df_erpos[[ax]] >= med_erpos, "High", "Low"),
    levels = c("Low", "High")
  )
  surv_df_tnbc[[paste0(ax, "_group")]] <- factor(
    ifelse(surv_df_tnbc[[ax]] >= med_tnbc, "High", "Low"),
    levels = c("Low", "High")
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# 24F — Log-rank tests (full mixed cohort)
# ----------------------------

logrank_results <- purrr::map_dfr(AXES_ORDER, function(ax) {

  grp_col <- paste0(ax, "_group")
  df_ax   <- surv_df[!is.na(surv_df[[grp_col]]), ]
  df_ax$surv_group <- df_ax[[grp_col]]

  sd_result <- survival::survdiff(
    Surv(os_time, os_status) ~ surv_group, data = df_ax
  )
  p_logrank <- 1 - pchisq(sd_result$chisq, df = 1)

  tibble::tibble(
    axis        = ax,
    analysis    = "full_mixed_cohort_exploratory",
    n_total     = nrow(df_ax),
    n_high      = sum(df_ax$surv_group == "High"),
    n_low       = sum(df_ax$surv_group == "Low"),
    events_high = sum(df_ax$os_status[df_ax$surv_group == "High"] == 1),
    events_low  = sum(df_ax$os_status[df_ax$surv_group == "Low"]  == 1),
    chisq       = sd_result$chisq,
    p_logrank   = p_logrank
  )
})

logrank_results <- logrank_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR_BH = p.adjust(p_logrank, method = "BH"),
    note   = "Exploratory; not powered for FDR significance"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_logrank)

readr::write_csv(
  logrank_results,
  file.path(paths$tables, "24_METABRIC_survival_OS_logrank_results.csv")
)

message("Log-rank results (mixed cohort, exploratory):")
print(logrank_results %>% dplyr::select(axis, n_total, p_logrank, FDR_BH))

# ----------------------------
# 24G — Cox PH (continuous score, univariable)
# ----------------------------

cox_results <- purrr::map_dfr(AXES_ORDER, function(ax) {

  df_ax   <- surv_df[is.finite(surv_df[[ax]]), ]
  cox_fit <- survival::coxph(
    Surv(os_time, os_status) ~ .,
    data = df_ax[, c("os_time", "os_status", ax)]
  )
  s <- summary(cox_fit)

  tibble::tibble(
    axis        = ax,
    analysis    = "univariable_continuous_exploratory",
    n           = s$n,
    events      = s$nevent,
    HR          = exp(coef(cox_fit)[1]),
    HR_lo95     = exp(confint(cox_fit)[1, 1]),
    HR_hi95     = exp(confint(cox_fit)[1, 2]),
    p_cox       = s$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    concordance = s$concordance["C"]
  )
})

cox_results <- cox_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR_BH = p.adjust(p_cox, method = "BH"),
    note   = "Exploratory univariable; not powered for FDR significance"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_cox)

readr::write_csv(
  cox_results,
  file.path(paths$tables, "24_METABRIC_survival_OS_cox_results.csv")
)

message("Cox univariable results:")
print(cox_results %>% dplyr::select(axis, HR, HR_lo95, HR_hi95, p_cox, FDR_BH))

# ----------------------------
# 24G2 — Multivariable Cox (age + grade + stage)
# ----------------------------

mv_covariate_cols <- c("AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS", "GRADE", "TUMOR_STAGE")
mv_cols_available <- intersect(mv_covariate_cols, names(clin_full))
mv_cols_missing   <- setdiff(mv_covariate_cols, names(clin_full))

if (length(mv_cols_missing) > 0) {
  warning(
    "Multivariable Cox: absent covariate columns excluded: ",
    paste(mv_cols_missing, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (length(mv_cols_available) == 0) {

  message("No multivariable covariates available — skipping 24G2.")
  multivariable_cox <- tibble::tibble(
    axis = AXES_ORDER,
    note = "Skipped: no covariate columns found in clin_full"
  )

} else {

  surv_df_mv <- surv_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      clin_full %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, dplyr::all_of(mv_cols_available)),
      by = "sample_id"
    )

  covariate_terms <- character(0)
  if ("AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS" %in% mv_cols_available) covariate_terms <- c(covariate_terms, "age_scaled")
  if ("GRADE"            %in% mv_cols_available) covariate_terms <- c(covariate_terms, "grade_factor")
  if ("TUMOR_STAGE"      %in% mv_cols_available) covariate_terms <- c(covariate_terms, "stage_factor")

  multivariable_cox <- purrr::map_dfr(AXES_ORDER, function(ax) {

    df_mv <- surv_df_mv %>% dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data[[ax]]))
    if ("AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS" %in% mv_cols_available) df_mv <- df_mv %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS))
    if ("GRADE"            %in% mv_cols_available) df_mv <- df_mv %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(GRADE))
    if ("TUMOR_STAGE"      %in% mv_cols_available) df_mv <- df_mv %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(TUMOR_STAGE))

    if (nrow(df_mv) < 50) {
      message("Skipping multivariable Cox for ", ax, ": n = ", nrow(df_mv))
      return(NULL)
    }

    if ("AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS" %in% mv_cols_available)
      df_mv <- df_mv %>% dplyr::mutate(age_scaled   = as.numeric(scale(AGE_AT_DIAGNOSIS)))
    if ("GRADE" %in% mv_cols_available)
      df_mv <- df_mv %>% dplyr::mutate(grade_factor = factor(GRADE))
    if ("TUMOR_STAGE" %in% mv_cols_available)
      df_mv <- df_mv %>% dplyr::mutate(stage_factor = factor(TUMOR_STAGE))

    formula_mv <- as.formula(
      paste0("survival::Surv(os_time, os_status) ~ `", ax, "` + ",
             paste(covariate_terms, collapse = " + "))
    )

    fit <- tryCatch(
      survival::coxph(formula_mv, data = df_mv),
      error = function(e) {
        message("Multivariable Cox failed for ", ax, ": ", e$message)
        NULL
      }
    )
    if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

    s <- summary(fit)
    tibble::tibble(
      axis            = ax,
      analysis        = "multivariable_continuous_exploratory",
      n               = s$n,
      HR_mv           = exp(coef(fit)[1]),
      lo95_mv         = exp(confint(fit)[1, 1]),
      hi95_mv         = exp(confint(fit)[1, 2]),
      p_mv            = s$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"],
      covariates_used = paste(covariate_terms, collapse = " + ")
    )
  }) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      FDR_BH_mv = p.adjust(p_mv, method = "BH"),
      note      = "Exploratory multivariable; not powered for FDR significance"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p_mv)
}

readr::write_csv(
  multivariable_cox,
  file.path(paths$tables, "24b_METABRIC_multivariable_cox_results.csv")
)

message("Multivariable Cox results:")
print(multivariable_cox)

# ----------------------------
# 24H — KM plot helper (parameterized)
# Parameters:
#   df            : survival dataframe (may be full cohort or subtype subset)
#   axis_name     : axis to plot
#   title_suffix  : appended to axis name in plot title
#   subtitle_extra: additional text appended to subtitle
#   base_font_size: controls all text inside plot (default 16)
#   risk_font_size: controls risk-table number size (default 5.5)
# ----------------------------

make_km_plot <- function(axis_name,
                         df,
                         lr_tbl         = logrank_results,
                         cox_tbl        = cox_results,
                         title_suffix   = "",
                         subtitle_extra = "",
                         group_colors   = c("Low" = "#2166AC", "High" = "#B2182B"),
                         base_font_size = 16,
                         risk_font_size = 5.5) {

  grp_col <- paste0(axis_name, "_group")
  df_ax   <- df[!is.na(df[[grp_col]]), ]
  df_ax$surv_group <- df_ax[[grp_col]]

  km_fit <- survival::survfit(
    Surv(os_time, os_status) ~ surv_group, data = df_ax
  )

  # Pull stats from provided tables (may differ for subtype-stratified versions)
  lr_row  <- lr_tbl[lr_tbl$axis == axis_name, ]
  cox_row <- cox_tbl[cox_tbl$axis == axis_name, ]

  if (nrow(lr_row) > 0 && !is.na(lr_row$p_logrank[1])) {
    p_val <- lr_row$p_logrank[1]
    p_label <- if (p_val < 0.001) "p\u202f<\u202f0.001" else
      paste0("p\u202f=\u202f", sprintf("%.3f", p_val))
    fdr_val   <- lr_row$FDR_BH[1]
    fdr_label <- if (!is.na(fdr_val)) {
      if (fdr_val < 0.001) "FDR\u202f<\u202f0.001" else
        paste0("FDR\u202f=\u202f", sprintf("%.3f", fdr_val))
    } else "FDR = n/a"
  } else {
    p_label   <- "p = n/a"
    fdr_label <- "FDR = n/a"
  }

  if (nrow(cox_row) > 0 && !is.na(cox_row$HR[1])) {
    hr_label <- sprintf(
      "HR\u202f=\u202f%.2f\u202f(95%%\u202fCI\u202f%.2f\u2013%.2f)",
      cox_row$HR[1], cox_row$HR_lo95[1], cox_row$HR_hi95[1]
    )
  } else {
    hr_label <- "HR = n/a"
  }

  axis_display <- gsub("_", "/", axis_name)
  subtitle_base <- paste0(p_label, "  |  ", fdr_label, "  |  ", hr_label)
  subtitle_full <- if (nchar(subtitle_extra) > 0)
    paste0(subtitle_base, "\n", subtitle_extra)
  else
    subtitle_base

  survminer::ggsurvplot(
    km_fit,
    data               = df_ax,
    palette            = group_colors,
    risk.table         = TRUE,
    risk.table.height  = 0.24,
    risk.table.title   = "Number at risk",
    risk.table.y.text  = TRUE,
    risk.table.y.text.col = TRUE,
    tables.theme       = survminer::theme_cleantable(),
    pval               = FALSE,
    conf.int           = TRUE,
    conf.int.alpha     = 0.14,
    xlab               = "Overall survival (months)",
    ylab               = "Survival probability",
    break.time.by      = 100,
    xlim               = c(0, 400),
    legend             = "top",
    legend.title       = paste0(axis_display, " (median split)"),
    legend.labs        = c("Low score", "High score"),
    title              = paste0(axis_display, " axis \u2014 Overall Survival",
                                title_suffix),
    subtitle           = subtitle_full,
    ggtheme            = theme_bw(base_size = base_font_size) +
      theme(
        plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold",
                                        size = base_font_size + 2,
                                        margin = margin(b = 4)),
        plot.subtitle    = element_text(size  = base_font_size - 1,
                                        color = "grey30",
                                        margin = margin(b = 8)),
        legend.position  = "top",
        legend.text      = element_text(size = base_font_size - 1),
        legend.title     = element_text(size = base_font_size - 1,
                                        face = "bold"),
        axis.title       = element_text(size = base_font_size),
        axis.text        = element_text(size = base_font_size - 2),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      ),
    fontsize = risk_font_size
  )
}

# Helper: combine plot + risk table into a single gtable

  gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
    p$plot, p$table,
    ncol    = 1,
    heights = c(plot_height, table_height)
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# 24K — Subtype-stratified KM for GPX4/Selenium (existing Supp Fig S7B)
#        Retained unchanged for manuscript compatibility.
# ----------------------------

surv_focused <- surv_df[!is.na(surv_df$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC), ]
subtype_km_plots_gpx4 <- list()

for (subtype in c("ERpos", "TNBC")) {

  df_sub <- surv_focused[surv_focused$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == subtype, ]

  if (nrow(df_sub) < 30 || sum(df_sub$os_status == 1) < 10) {
    message("Skipping subtype KM for ", subtype,
            ": insufficient events.")
    next
  }

  med_sub <- median(df_sub$GPX4_Selenium, na.rm = TRUE)
  df_sub$surv_group <- factor(
    ifelse(df_sub$GPX4_Selenium >= med_sub, "High", "Low"),
    levels = c("Low", "High")
  )

  km_sub  <- survival::survfit(
    Surv(os_time, os_status) ~ surv_group, data = df_sub)
  lr_sub  <- survival::survdiff(
    Surv(os_time, os_status) ~ surv_group, data = df_sub)
  p_sub   <- 1 - pchisq(lr_sub$chisq, df = 1)
  cox_sub <- survival::coxph(
    Surv(os_time, os_status) ~ GPX4_Selenium, data = df_sub)

  p_lbl  <- if (p_sub < 0.001) "p\u202f<\u202f0.001" else
    paste0("p\u202f=\u202f", sprintf("%.3f", p_sub))
  hr_lbl <- sprintf(
    "HR\u202f=\u202f%.2f\u202f(95%%\u202fCI\u202f%.2f\u2013%.2f)",
    exp(coef(cox_sub)[1]),
    exp(confint(cox_sub)[1, 1]),
    exp(confint(cox_sub)[1, 2])
  )

  pal <- if (subtype == "ERpos") {
    c("Low" = "#F4A582", "High" = "#B2182B")
  } else {
    c("Low" = "#92C5DE", "High" = "#2166AC")
  }

  subtype_km_plots_gpx4[[subtype]] <- survminer::ggsurvplot(
    km_sub,
    data               = df_sub,
    palette            = pal,
    risk.table         = TRUE,
    risk.table.height  = 0.24,
    risk.table.title   = "Number at risk",
    tables.theme       = survminer::theme_cleantable(),
    pval               = FALSE,
    conf.int           = TRUE,
    conf.int.alpha     = 0.14,
    xlab               = "Overall survival (months)",
    ylab               = "Survival probability",
    break.time.by      = 100,
    legend.title       = "GPX4/Se (median split\nwithin subtype)",
    legend.labs        = c("Low score", "High score"),
    title              = paste0("GPX4/Selenium \u2014 OS within ",
                                subtype, " only"),
    subtitle           = paste0(p_lbl, "  |  ", hr_lbl,
                                "\nWithin-subtype exploratory analysis"),
    ggtheme            = theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
      theme(
        plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
        plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey30"),
        legend.position  = "top",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      ),
    fontsize = 5.5
  )
}

if (length(subtype_km_plots_gpx4) >= 1) {

# ----------------------------
# 24K2 — NEW: Subtype-stratified log-rank + Cox for ALL 8 axes
#             within ERpos and TNBC separately.
#             Produces Supplementary Table S7C.
#
# Rationale: If subtype composition confounds the mixed-cohort GPX4/Selenium
# signal (shown in 24K), reviewers will ask whether Iron Handling and FSP1/CoQ
# multivariable associations are similarly composition-driven. This analysis
# pre-empts that question by reporting within-subtype associations for all
# eight axes.
#
# NOTE: Within-subtype analyses are severely underpowered, especially in TNBC
# (n ≈ 201, ~100 events). Results are reported for transparency and should
# be interpreted as directional evidence only. Sample sizes and event counts
# are reported per row to make the power limitation explicit.
# ----------------------------

message("\n--- 24K2: Subtype-stratified survival for ALL 8 axes (Supp Table S7C) ---")

run_stratified_survival <- function(surv_subset, ax, subtype_label) {

  grp_col <- paste0(ax, "_group")

  df_ax <- surv_subset[!is.na(surv_subset[[grp_col]]), ]
  df_ax$surv_group <- df_ax[[grp_col]]

  n_total <- nrow(df_ax)
  n_events <- sum(df_ax$os_status == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_high <- sum(df_ax$surv_group == "High", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_low  <- sum(df_ax$surv_group == "Low",  na.rm = TRUE)

  # Skip if underpowered (< 20 events)
  if (n_events < 20 || n_total < 40) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      axis             = ax,
      subtype          = subtype_label,
      n_total          = n_total,
      n_events         = n_events,
      n_high           = n_high,
      n_low            = n_low,
      lr_chisq         = NA_real_,
      lr_p             = NA_real_,
      FDR_BH_within    = NA_real_,
      HR_continuous    = NA_real_,
      HR_lo95          = NA_real_,
      HR_hi95          = NA_real_,
      p_cox_continuous = NA_real_,
      interpretation   = "Insufficient events for reliable estimation (n_events < 20)"
    ))
  }

  # Log-rank
  lr_res  <- survival::survdiff(
    Surv(os_time, os_status) ~ surv_group, data = df_ax
  )
  lr_p    <- 1 - pchisq(lr_res$chisq, df = 1)

  # Cox (continuous score)
  cox_fit <- tryCatch(
    survival::coxph(
      Surv(os_time, os_status) ~ .,
      data = df_ax[, c("os_time", "os_status", ax)]
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(cox_fit)) {
    HR <- NA_real_; lo <- NA_real_; hi <- NA_real_; p_cox <- NA_real_
  } else {
    HR    <- exp(coef(cox_fit)[1])
    lo    <- exp(confint(cox_fit)[1, 1])
    hi    <- exp(confint(cox_fit)[1, 2])
    p_cox <- summary(cox_fit)$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    axis             = ax,
    subtype          = subtype_label,
    n_total          = n_total,
    n_events         = n_events,
    n_high           = n_high,
    n_low            = n_low,
    lr_chisq         = lr_res$chisq,
    lr_p             = lr_p,
    FDR_BH_within    = NA_real_,   # filled after binding all results
    HR_continuous    = HR,
    HR_lo95          = lo,
    HR_hi95          = hi,
    p_cox_continuous = p_cox,
    interpretation   = "Exploratory within-subtype (severely underpowered in TNBC)"
  )
}

# Run for all axes × both subtypes
stratified_results_list <- list()

for (ax in AXES_ORDER) {

  # ERpos
  stratified_results_list[[paste0(ax, "_ERpos")]] <-
    run_stratified_survival(surv_df_erpos, ax, "ERpos")

  # TNBC
  stratified_results_list[[paste0(ax, "_TNBC")]] <-
    run_stratified_survival(surv_df_tnbc, ax, "TNBC")
}

stratified_all_axes <- dplyr::bind_rows(stratified_results_list)

# Apply within-subtype BH-FDR correction separately for ERpos and TNBC
stratified_all_axes <- stratified_all_axes %>%
  dplyr::group_by(subtype) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR_BH_within = p.adjust(lr_p, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(subtype, lr_p)

# Save as Supplementary Table S7C
readr::write_csv(
  stratified_all_axes,
  file.path(paths$tables,
            "24c_METABRIC_survival_subtype_stratified_all_axes_TableS7C.csv")
)

message("Supplementary Table S7C saved.")
message("Subtype-stratified results (all 8 axes):")
print(
  stratified_all_axes %>%
    dplyr::select(axis, subtype, n_total, n_events, lr_p, FDR_BH_within,
                  HR_continuous, HR_lo95, HR_hi95)
)

# ----------------------------
# 24K3 — NEW: Subtype-stratified KM panel figures (Supp Fig S7C)
#             Saves one 2-panel figure per axis (ERpos left, TNBC right).
#             Only saves for axes with sufficient events in both groups.
# ----------------------------

message("\n--- 24K3: Subtype-stratified KM panels per axis (Supp Fig S7C) ---")

for (ax in AXES_ORDER) {

  grp_col <- paste0(ax, "_group")

  # Build per-subtype stat tables for make_km_plot
  build_mini_stats <- function(df_sub, subtype_label) {
    n_ev <- sum(df_sub$os_status == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (n_ev < 10 || nrow(df_sub) < 30) return(NULL)

    df_ax <- df_sub[!is.na(df_sub[[grp_col]]), ]
    df_ax$surv_group <- df_ax[[grp_col]]

    lr   <- tryCatch(
      survival::survdiff(Surv(os_time, os_status) ~ surv_group, data = df_ax),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(lr)) return(NULL)

    lr_p_val <- 1 - pchisq(lr$chisq, df = 1)

    cox_c <- tryCatch(
      survival::coxph(
        Surv(os_time, os_status) ~ .,
        data = df_ax[, c("os_time", "os_status", ax)]
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(cox_c)) return(NULL)

    tibble::tibble(
      axis    = ax,
      p_logrank = lr_p_val,
      FDR_BH    = NA_real_,
      HR        = exp(coef(cox_c)[1]),
      HR_lo95   = exp(confint(cox_c)[1, 1]),
      HR_hi95   = exp(confint(cox_c)[1, 2])
    )
  }

  mini_lr_erpos <- build_mini_stats(surv_df_erpos, "ERpos")
  mini_lr_tnbc  <- build_mini_stats(surv_df_tnbc,  "TNBC")

  if (is.null(mini_lr_erpos) && is.null(mini_lr_tnbc)) {
    message("Skipping subtype-stratified KM panel for ", ax,
            ": insufficient events in both subtypes.")
    next
  }

  panels <- list()

  if (!is.null(mini_lr_erpos)) {
    # Need a mini cox table with the right column names for make_km_plot
    mini_cox_erpos <- mini_lr_erpos %>%
      dplyr::rename(p_cox = p_logrank)   # placeholder so function works

    p_er <- tryCatch(
      make_km_plot(
        ax, surv_df_erpos,
        lr_tbl         = mini_lr_erpos,
        cox_tbl        = mini_cox_erpos,
        title_suffix   = " \u2014 ERpos only",
        subtitle_extra = paste0("Within-subtype exploratory; n = ",
                                nrow(surv_df_erpos),
                                " | events = ",
                                sum(surv_df_erpos$os_status == 1)),
        group_colors   = c("Low" = "#F4A582", "High" = "#B2182B"),
        base_font_size = 15,
        risk_font_size = 5.2
      ),
      error = function(e) { message("ERpos KM failed for ", ax); NULL }
    )
    if (!is.null(p_er)) panels[["ERpos"]] <- p_er
  }

  if (!is.null(mini_lr_tnbc)) {
    mini_cox_tnbc <- mini_lr_tnbc %>%
      dplyr::rename(p_cox = p_logrank)

    p_tn <- tryCatch(
      make_km_plot(
        ax, surv_df_tnbc,
        lr_tbl         = mini_lr_tnbc,
        cox_tbl        = mini_cox_tnbc,
        title_suffix   = " \u2014 TNBC only",
        subtitle_extra = paste0("Within-subtype exploratory; n = ",
                                nrow(surv_df_tnbc),
                                " | events = ",
                                sum(surv_df_tnbc$os_status == 1)),
        group_colors   = c("Low" = "#92C5DE", "High" = "#2166AC"),
        base_font_size = 15,
        risk_font_size = 5.2
      ),
      error = function(e) { message("TNBC KM failed for ", ax); NULL }
    )
    if (!is.null(p_tn)) panels[["TNBC"]] <- p_tn
  }

  if (length(panels) == 0) next

  panel_grobs <- lapply(panels, km_grob, plot_height = 3.8, table_height = 1.1)
  n_p <- length(panel_grobs)

  png(
    file.path(paths$figures,
              paste0("24_METABRIC_KM_subtype_stratified_", ax, ".png")),
    width  = n_p * 3500,
    height = 4800,
    res    = 300,
    bg     = "white"
  )
  do.call(
    gridExtra::grid.arrange,
    c(panel_grobs,
      list(
        ncol = n_p,
        top  = grid::textGrob(
          paste0("Supp Fig S7C — ", gsub("_", "/", ax),
                 ": within-subtype OS analysis (exploratory)"),
          gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 20, fontface = "bold")
        )
      )
    )
  )
  dev.off()
  message("  Saved: 24_METABRIC_KM_subtype_stratified_", ax, ".png")
}

# ----------------------------
# 24K4 — NEW: Subtype-stratified HR forest plot (Supp Fig S7D)
#             Shows HR (continuous axis score) within ERpos and TNBC
#             for all 8 axes side by side.
# ----------------------------

message("\n--- 24K4: Subtype-stratified HR forest plot (Supp Fig S7D) ---")

forest_strat_df <- stratified_all_axes %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(HR_continuous)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    axis    = factor(axis, levels = rev(AXES_ORDER)),
    subtype = factor(subtype, levels = c("ERpos", "TNBC")),
    sig     = !is.na(p_cox_continuous) & p_cox_continuous < 0.05,
    label   = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f\u2013%.2f)\nn=%d, ev=%d",
                      HR_continuous, HR_lo95, HR_hi95,
                      n_total, n_events),
    power_note = ifelse(
      n_events < 20,
      "< 20 events\n(not shown)",
      NA_character_
    )
  )

p_strat_forest <- ggplot(
  forest_strat_df %>% dplyr::filter(n_events >= 20),
  aes(x = HR_continuous, y = axis, color = subtype, shape = sig)
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey40") +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = HR_lo95, xmax = HR_hi95),
    height   = 0.25,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.55)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3.5,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.55)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("ERpos" = "#B2182B", "TNBC" = "#2166AC"),
    name   = "Subtype"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = 16, "FALSE" = 1),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "p < 0.05", "FALSE" = "p \u2265 0.05"),
    name   = "Within-subtype p"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Hazard ratio (95% CI)\ncontinuous axis score") +
  scale_y_discrete(
    name   = NULL,
    labels = function(x) gsub("_", "/", x)
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = paste0(
      " Within-subtype survival associations",
      " for all eight ferroptosis axes in METABRIC"
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Cox PH with continuous axis score; stratified within ERpos (n = ",
      nrow(surv_df_erpos), ") and TNBC (n = ", nrow(surv_df_tnbc), ")\n",
      "Axes with < 20 events in a subtype are excluded from display. ",
      "All results are exploratory and underpowered."
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey30",
                                    lineheight = 1.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.box       = "horizontal"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures,
            "24_METABRIC_survival_subtype_stratified_HR_forest.png"),
  p_strat_forest,
  width  = 9.5,
  height = 6.5,
  dpi    = 300,

# 24L — Univariable Cox forest plot (Figure 7B, mixed cohort)

p_cox_forest <- cox_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    axis        = factor(axis, levels = rev(AXES_ORDER)),
    significant = !is.na(FDR_BH) & FDR_BH < 0.05,
    label       = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f\u2013%.2f)",
                          HR, HR_lo95, HR_hi95)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = HR, y = axis)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = HR_lo95, xmax = HR_hi95, color = significant),
    height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = significant), size = 3.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = max(HR_hi95, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.06, label = label),
    hjust = 0, size = 3.8
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#B2182B", "FALSE" = "grey50"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "FDR\u202f<\u202f0.05",
               "FALSE" = "Not significant"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.38))) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub("_", "/", x)) +
  labs(
    title    = paste0(
      "METABRIC: Hazard ratio for OS by ferroptosis axis score",
      " (univariable Cox PH, mixed cohort)"
    ),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Continuous axis score entered as predictor; n = 1,756; 1,044 events.\n",
      "Pre-specified exploratory analysis. No axis reaches BH-FDR < 0.05."
    ),
    x = "Hazard ratio (95% CI)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey30",
                                    lineheight = 1.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "bottom"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(paths$figures, "24_METABRIC_survival_HR_forest_plot.png"),
  p_cox_forest, width = 9.5, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)
```

Survival analysis in METABRIC (n = 1,756; 1,044 events) revealed nominal associations between ferroptosis axis scores and OS. High Lipid_Peroxidation axis score was associated with shorter OS (log-rank p = 0.045; HR = 1.19, 95% CI 1.03–1.39), and high GPX4_Selenium axis score showed a trend toward better OS (log-rank p = 0.020; HR = 0.92, 95% CI 0.80–1.05), directionally consistent with the ferroptosis-pressure and ferroptosis-buffering states identified in the transcriptomic analysis. However, no axis reached BH-FDR significance after correction for eight comparisons (minimum FDR = 0.08), likely reflecting limited statistical power in the absence of subtype stratification. Subtype-stratified analysis demonstrated that the GPX4_Selenium OS association was not significant within ERpos (p = 0.303) or TNBC (p = 0.226) individually, suggesting this signal is partially driven by sub type composition rather than within-subtype GPX4 biology.

```{r MANUSCRIPT NUMBER EXTRACTOR}
safe_read <- function(fp, label) {
  if (file.exists(fp)) {
    df <- tryCatch(
      readr::read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE),
      error = function(e) { cat("[ERROR]", label, ":", e$message, "\n"); NULL }
    )
    if (!is.null(df)) cat("[OK]    ", label, "\n")
    return(df)
  } else {
    cat("[MISSING]", label, "->", basename(fp), "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(erpos_sig)))
      cat(sprintf("  %s: Cliff's delta = %.3f, FDR = %.2e [%s]\n",
                  erpos_sig$axis[i], erpos_sig$cliffs_delta[i],
                  erpos_sig$wilcox_fdr[i], erpos_sig$evidence[i]))
  } else cat("  none at current thresholds\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 4 — DOWNSAMPLING ROBUSTNESS  (Results)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n=============================================================================\n")
cat("SECTION 4: DOWNSAMPLING ROBUSTNESS\n")
cat("=============================================================================\n")

if (!is.null(down)) {
  B_val <- if ("B" %in% names(down)) down$B[1] else 500
  cat(sprintf("\n[RESULTS TABLE] Downsampling (B = %d iterations):\n", B_val))
  cat(sprintf("  %-22s  %9s  %9s  %9s  %s\n",
              "Axis", "Median_d", "CI_lo95", "CI_hi95", "Robustness"))
  cat(paste(rep("-", 72), collapse = ""), "\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(down)))
    cat(sprintf("  %-22s  %9.3f  %9.3f  %9.3f  %s\n",
                down$axis[i], down$median_delta[i],
                down$q025[i], down$q975[i], down$robustness[i]))

  strong <- down %>% filter(robustness == "Strong") %>% pull(axis)
  mod    <- down %>% filter(robustness == "Moderate") %>% pull(axis)
  weak   <- down %>% filter(robustness == "Weak")   %>% pull(axis)
  cat(sprintf("\n[KEY NUMBERS] Strong:   %s\n", paste(strong, collapse = ", ")))
  cat(sprintf("[KEY NUMBERS] Moderate: %s\n",   paste(mod,    collapse = ", ")))
  cat(sprintf("[KEY NUMBERS] Weak:     %s\n",   paste(weak,   collapse = ", ")))
}

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 5 — DIFFERENTIAL WIRING  (Results — KEY FINDING)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n=============================================================================\n")
cat("SECTION 5: DIFFERENTIAL WIRING — KEY FINDING\n")
cat("=============================================================================\n")

if (!is.null(perm)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n[KEY NUMBERS] Total axis-pair combinations tested:   %d\n", all_n))
  cat(sprintf("[KEY NUMBERS] FDR-significant edges (FDR < 0.05):   %d\n", sig_n))
  cat(sprintf("[KEY NUMBERS] Stronger in TNBC:                      %d\n", tnbc_n))
  cat(sprintf("[KEY NUMBERS] Stronger in ERpos:                     %d\n", erpos_n))

  if (sig_n > 0) {
    cat("\n[RESULTS TABLE] FDR-significant differential wiring edges:\n")
    cat(sprintf("  %-28s  %10s  %12s  %10s  %s\n",
                "Edge", "Delta_rho", "FDR_BH", "Abs_delta", "Evidence"))
    cat(paste(rep("-", 80), collapse = ""), "\n")
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(sig_edges))) {
      lbl <- paste0(sig_edges$axis_1[i], " <-> ", sig_edges$axis_2[i])
      cat(sprintf("  %-28s  %10.3f  %12.4f  %10.3f  %s\n",
                  lbl, sig_edges$delta_rho[i], sig_edges$empirical_fdr[i],
                  sig_edges$abs_delta_rho[i], sig_edges$evidence[i]))
    }
    if (nrow(top2) >= 1) {
      cat("\n[KEY NUMBERS] Top 2 rewired edges for manuscript text:\n")
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(top2)))
        cat(sprintf("  %s <-> %s: delta-rho = +%.3f, FDR = %.4f\n",
                    top2$axis_1[i], top2$axis_2[i],
                    top2$delta_rho[i], top2$empirical_fdr[i]))
    }
  } else {
    cat("\n[NOTE] No FDR < 0.05 edges in METABRIC (smaller TNBC n than GSE96058).\n")
    cat("Top 5 edges by |delta rho| (report with nominal permutation p):\n")
    top5 <- perm %>% arrange(empirical_p) %>% slice_head(n = 5)
    cat(sprintf("  %-28s  %10s  %12s\n", "Edge", "Delta_rho", "perm_p"))
    cat(paste(rep("-", 56), collapse = ""), "\n")
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(top5))) {
      lbl <- paste0(top5$axis_1[i], " <-> ", top5$axis_2[i])
      cat(sprintf("  %-28s  %10.3f  %12.4f\n",
                  lbl, top5$delta_rho[i], top5$empirical_p[i]))
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("\n  Permutation wiring file not found (run Chunk 19 first).\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 6 — COMBINED VALIDATION CALL  (Results summary)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n=============================================================================\n")
cat("SECTION 6: COMBINED VALIDATION CALL\n")
cat("=============================================================================\n")

if (!is.null(val)) {
  cat("\n[RESULTS TABLE] Axis validation (activity + robustness + wiring):\n")
  cat(sprintf("  %-22s  %9s  %12s  %7s  %s\n",
              "Axis", "Cliff_d", "Robustness", "Wiring", "Call"))
  cat(paste(rep("-", 82), collapse = ""), "\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(val))) {
    wn <- if ("n_FDR_significant_wiring_edges" %in% names(val))
      val$n_FDR_significant_wiring_edges[i] else NA
    cat(sprintf("  %-22s  %9.3f  %12s  %7s  %s\n",
                val$axis[i], val$cliffs_delta[i],
                val$downsample_robustness[i],
                ifelse(is.na(wn), "?", as.character(wn)),
                val$validation_call[i]))
  }
  strong_val <- val %>% filter(grepl("Strong", validation_call)) %>% pull(axis)
  cat(sprintf("\n[KEY NUMBERS] Strongly validated axes: %s\n",
              paste(strong_val, collapse = ", ")))
}

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 7 — MARKER VALIDATION  (Results 4.6)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n=============================================================================\n")
cat("SECTION 7: MARKER VALIDATION\n")
cat("=============================================================================\n")

if (!is.null(markers)) {
  cat("\n[RESULTS TABLE] Discovery marker validation in METABRIC:\n")
  cat(sprintf("  %-10s  %-22s  %7s  %7s  %9s  %12s  %-22s  %s\n",
              "Gene", "Axis", "nERpos", "nTNBC", "Cliff_d", "FDR_BH",
              "Evidence", "Direction"))
  cat(paste(rep("-", 105), collapse = ""), "\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(markers))) {
    cat(sprintf("  %-10s  %-22s  %7d  %7d  %9.3f  %12.2e  %-22s  %s\n",
                markers$gene[i], markers$axis[i],
                markers$n_ERpos[i], markers$n_TNBC[i],
                markers$cliffs_delta[i], markers$wilcox_fdr[i],
                markers$validation_evidence[i], markers$direction[i]))
  }
}

if (!is.null(cross)) {
  cat("\n[RESULTS TABLE] Cross-cohort concordance (GSE96058 vs METABRIC):\n")
  cat(sprintf("  %-10s  %-22s  %12s  %12s  %6s  %s\n",
              "Gene", "Axis", "Discovery_d", "METABRIC_d", "Match", "Strength"))
  cat(paste(rep("-", 88), collapse = ""), "\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(cross))) {
    cat(sprintf("  %-10s  %-22s  %12.3f  %12.3f  %6s  %s\n",
                cross$gene[i], cross$axis[i],
                cross$delta_disc[i], cross$delta_val[i],
                ifelse(cross$concordant_direction[i], "YES", "NO"),
                cross$validation_strength[i]))
  }
  n_conc <- sum(cross$concordant_direction, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("\n[KEY NUMBERS] Concordant markers: %d / %d\n", n_conc, nrow(cross)))

  strong_rep <- cross %>% filter(validation_strength == "Strong_replicated") %>% pull(gene)
  dir_cons   <- cross %>% filter(validation_strength == "Directional_consistent") %>% pull(gene)
  cat(sprintf("[KEY NUMBERS] Strong replicated:         %s\n",
              paste(strong_rep, collapse = ", ")))
  cat(sprintf("[KEY NUMBERS] Directional consistent:    %s\n",
              paste(dir_cons,   collapse = ", ")))
}

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 8 — SURVIVAL ANALYSIS  (Results — Clinical relevance)
# =============================================================================
cat("\n=============================================================================\n")
cat("SECTION 8: SURVIVAL ANALYSIS\n")
cat("=============================================================================\n")

if (!is.null(surv_qc)) {
  cat("\n[METHODS] Survival cohort:\n")
  cat(sprintf("  n with OS data:       %d\n", surv_qc$n_survival_samples))
  cat(sprintf("  Events (deaths):      %d\n", surv_qc$n_events))
  cat(sprintf("  Median OS (months):   %.1f\n", surv_qc$median_os_months))
} else {
  cat("\n  Survival QC file not found — run Chunk 24 first.\n")
}

if (!is.null(lr)) {
  cat("\n[RESULTS TABLE] Log-rank test (median-split per axis):\n")
  cat(sprintf("  %-22s  %8s  %8s  %10s  %12s  %12s  %s\n",
              "Axis", "n_High", "n_Low", "events_H", "LR_p", "FDR_BH", "Sig"))
  cat(paste(rep("-", 90), collapse = ""), "\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(lr))) {
    flag <- if (!is.na(lr$FDR_BH[i]) && lr$FDR_BH[i] < 0.05) "  ***" else ""
    cat(sprintf("  %-22s  %8d  %8d  %10d  %12.4f  %12.4f%s\n",
                lr$axis[i], lr$n_high[i], lr$n_low[i],
                lr$events_high[i], lr$p_logrank[i], lr$FDR_BH[i], flag))
  }
  cat(sprintf("\n[KEY NUMBERS] FDR-significant survival axes: %s\n",
              if (length(sig_surv) > 0) paste(sig_surv, collapse = ", ")
              else "none at FDR < 0.05"))
}

if (!is.null(cox_df)) {
  cat("\n[RESULTS TABLE] Cox proportional hazards (continuous axis score):\n")
  cat(sprintf("  %-22s  %8s  %10s  %10s  %10s  %10s  %s\n",
              "Axis", "HR", "HR_lo95", "HR_hi95", "p_cox", "FDR_BH", "Sig"))
  cat(paste(rep("-", 88), collapse = ""), "\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(cox_df))) {
    flag <- if (!is.na(cox_df$FDR_BH[i]) && cox_df$FDR_BH[i] < 0.05) "  ***" else ""
    cat(sprintf("  %-22s  %8.3f  %10.3f  %10.3f  %10.4f  %10.4f%s\n",
                cox_df$axis[i], cox_df$HR[i], cox_df$HR_lo95[i],
                cox_df$HR_hi95[i], cox_df$p_cox[i], cox_df$FDR_BH[i], flag))
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 9 — READY-TO-PASTE MANUSCRIPT SENTENCES
# =============================================================================
cat("\n=============================================================================\n")
cat("SECTION 9: READY-TO-PASTE MANUSCRIPT SENTENCES\n")
cat("=============================================================================\n")

cat("\n--- METHODS: Cohort ---\n")
if (!is.null(align))
  cat(sprintf("The METABRIC validation cohort comprised %d primary breast tumour samples with matched microarray expression and clinical annotation.\n",
              align$matched_samples))

if (!is.null(pam50_rep)) {
  lA <- pam50_rep$n[pam50_rep$pam50_simple == "LumA"]
  lB <- pam50_rep$n[pam50_rep$pam50_simple == "LumB"]
  h2 <- pam50_rep$n[pam50_rep$pam50_simple == "HER2_enriched"]
  ba <- pam50_rep$n[pam50_rep$pam50_simple == "Basal"]
  nl <- pam50_rep$n[pam50_rep$pam50_simple == "Normal_like"]
  tot <- sum(pam50_rep$n, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("Intrinsic subtype distribution (n=%d): LumA (n=%d, %.1f%%), LumB (n=%d, %.1f%%), HER2-enriched (n=%d, %.1f%%), Basal (n=%d, %.1f%%), Normal-like (n=%d, %.1f%%).\n",
              tot, lA, 100*lA/tot, lB, 100*lB/tot, h2, 100*h2/tot,
              ba, 100*ba/tot, nl, 100*nl/tot))
}
if (!is.null(focused_rep)) {
  ne <- focused_rep$n[focused_rep$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "ERpos"]
  nt <- focused_rep$n[focused_rep$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"]
  cat(sprintf("The focused ERpos vs TNBC contrast included %d ERpos and %d TNBC samples.\n", ne, nt))
}
if (!is.null(cov)) {
  pct <- round(100 * sum(cov$n_genes_present) / sum(cov$n_genes_defined))
  cat(sprintf("All %d of 46 ferroptosis core axis genes were detected in the METABRIC microarray matrix (%d%% coverage).\n",
              sum(cov$n_genes_present), pct))
}

cat("\n--- RESULTS: Axis signature ---\n")
if (!is.null(sig)) {
  tnbc_s  <- sig %>% filter(direction == "Higher_in_TNBC",
                              evidence %in% c("Strong", "Moderate"))
  erpos_s <- sig %>% filter(direction == "Higher_in_ERpos",
                              evidence %in% c("Strong", "Moderate"))
  if (nrow(tnbc_s) > 0) {
    t1 <- tnbc_s[1, ]
    cat(sprintf("In METABRIC validation, TNBC tumours consistently exhibited higher %s axis activity (Cliff's delta = +%.3f, BH-FDR = %.2e, %s evidence), replicating the GSE96058 discovery finding.\n",
                t1$axis, t1$cliffs_delta, t1$wilcox_fdr, t1$evidence))
  }
  if (nrow(erpos_s) > 0) {
    e1 <- erpos_s[1, ]
    cat(sprintf("ERpos tumours showed higher %s axis activity (Cliff's delta = %.3f, BH-FDR = %.2e, %s evidence), consistent with the ferroptosis-buffered state identified in discovery.\n",
                e1$axis, e1$cliffs_delta, e1$wilcox_fdr, e1$evidence))
  }
}

cat("\n--- RESULTS: Downsampling ---\n")
if (!is.null(down)) {
  B_val <- if ("B" %in% names(down)) down$B[1] else 500
  s_axes <- down %>% filter(robustness == "Strong") %>% pull(axis)
  w_axes <- down %>% filter(robustness == "Weak")   %>% pull(axis)
  cat(sprintf("Balanced downsampling of ERpos to TNBC size (B = %d iterations) confirmed robustness of %s axis differences; %s showed weak or unstable directions.\n",
              B_val,
              paste(s_axes, collapse = ", "),
              paste(w_axes, collapse = ", ")))
}

cat("\n--- RESULTS: Differential wiring ---\n")
if (!is.null(perm)) {
  if (sig_n > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("Of %d unique axis-pair combinations tested in METABRIC, %d exhibited FDR-significant differential wiring between ERpos and TNBC (BH-FDR < 0.05, permutation B = 2,000), all %d stronger in TNBC.\n",
                all_n, sig_n, tnbc_n))
    if (nrow(top2) >= 1)
      cat(sprintf("The most prominent rewired edges included %s <-> %s (delta-rho = +%.3f, FDR = %.4f)",
                  top2$axis_1[1], top2$axis_2[1],
                  top2$delta_rho[1], top2$empirical_fdr[1]))
    if (nrow(top2) >= 2)
      cat(sprintf(" and %s <-> %s (delta-rho = +%.3f, FDR = %.4f).",
                  top2$axis_1[2], top2$axis_2[2],
                  top2$delta_rho[2], top2$empirical_fdr[2]))
    cat("\n")
  } else {
    best <- perm %>% arrange(empirical_p) %>% slice_head(n = 1)
    cat(sprintf("Permutation-tested differential wiring in METABRIC (B = 2,000) did not reach FDR < 0.05 across %d axis-pair combinations, likely reflecting the smaller TNBC sample size (n = %d vs n = 320 in GSE96058). The top ranked edge was %s <-> %s (delta-rho = +%.3f, perm p = %.3f), consistent in direction with the GSE96058 finding.\n",
                all_n, if (!is.null(focused_rep)) {
                  focused_rep$n[focused_rep$focused_group_ERpos_TNBC == "TNBC"]
                } else 320,
                best$axis_1, best$axis_2, best$delta_rho[1], best$empirical_p[1]))
  }
}

cat("\n--- RESULTS: Markers ---\n")
if (!is.null(cross)) {
  n_conc     <- sum(cross$concordant_direction, na.rm = TRUE)
  strong_rep <- cross %>% filter(validation_strength == "Strong_replicated") %>% pull(gene)
  cat(sprintf("%d of %d discovery-selected markers showed directionally concordant expression differences between ERpos and TNBC in METABRIC.\n",
              n_conc, nrow(cross)))
  if (length(strong_rep) > 0)
    cat(sprintf("%s reached strong replication (BH-FDR < 0.05 in both cohorts with concordant direction).\n",
                paste(strong_rep, collapse = ", ")))
}

cat("\n--- RESULTS: Survival ---\n")
if (!is.null(surv_qc))
  cat(sprintf("Survival analysis was performed in %d METABRIC samples with available overall survival data (%d events; median OS = %.1f months).\n",
              surv_qc$n_survival_samples, surv_qc$n_events, surv_qc$median_os_months))

if (!is.null(lr)) {
  if (length(sig_surv) > 0) {
    for (ax in sig_surv) {
      lr_row <- lr[lr$axis == ax, ]
      cat(sprintf("High %s axis score was significantly associated with OS (log-rank p = %.4f, BH-FDR = %.4f",
                  ax, lr_row$p_logrank, lr_row$FDR_BH))
      if (!is.null(cox_df) && ax %in% cox_df$axis) {
        cr <- cox_df[cox_df$axis == ax, ]
        cat(sprintf("; HR = %.2f, 95%% CI %.2f-%.2f, Cox p = %.4f",
                    cr$HR, cr$HR_lo95, cr$HR_hi95, cr$p_cox))
      }
      cat(").\n")
    }
  } else {
    best_lr <- lr %>% arrange(p_logrank) %>% slice_head(n = 2)
    cat("No axis reached BH-FDR < 0.05 for overall survival at the METABRIC sample size.\n")
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(best_lr))) {
      cat(sprintf("  %s showed the strongest trend: log-rank p = %.4f (FDR = %.4f).\n",
                  best_lr$axis[i], best_lr$p_logrank[i], best_lr$FDR_BH[i]))
    }
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 10 — SAVE FULL REPORT TO FILE
# =============================================================================
cat("\n=============================================================================\n")
cat("SECTION 10: SAVING REPORT\n")
cat("=============================================================================\n")

dir.create(paths$manuscript, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
report_fp <- file.path(paths$manuscript, "METABRIC_manuscript_numbers_report.txt")

sink(report_fp)

cat("METABRIC MANUSCRIPT NUMBERS — FULL REPORT\n")
cat("Project root:", root, "\n")
cat("Generated:   ", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n\n")

sections <- list(
  "COHORT ALIGNMENT"           = align,
  "PAM50 COUNTS (RAW)"         = pam50_raw,
  "FOCUSED COUNTS (RAW)"       = focused_raw,
  "PAM50/RECEPTOR CONCORDANCE" = concordance,
  "PAM50 ANALYSIS COHORT"      = pam50_rep,
  "FOCUSED ANALYSIS COHORT"    = focused_rep,
  "AXIS GENE COVERAGE"         = cov,
  "ERpos vs TNBC SIGNATURE"    = sig,
  "DOWNSAMPLING ROBUSTNESS"    = down,
  "WIRING — ALL EDGES"         = perm,
  "COMBINED VALIDATION"        = val,
  "MARKER VALIDATION"          = markers,
  "CROSS-COHORT CONCORDANCE"   = cross,
  "SURVIVAL QC"                = surv_qc,
  "LOG-RANK RESULTS"           = lr,
  "COX HR RESULTS"             = cox_df
)

for (nm in names(sections)) {
  df <- sections[[nm]]
  if (!is.null(df)) {
    cat("===", nm, "===\n")
    print(as.data.frame(df))
    cat("\n")
  }
}

sink()

cat("\nFull report saved to:\n ", report_fp, "\n")
cat("\n=============================================================================\n")
cat("EXTRACTION COMPLETE\n")
cat("=============================================================================\n\n")
```
